course_faqs.question: What is the fee for PGDM at Jaipuria Noida after scholarship?
course_faqs.answer: Students after getting selected for PGDM scholarship at Jaipuria Institute of Management Noida get a waiver of INR 3.50 Lacs or INR 2.50 Lacs depending on the CAT score of the candidates. The total fee for PGDM is INR 12.25 Lacs for students with CAT score 80% and above. For students with CAT score of 70% and above have to pay a PGDM fee of INR 13.25 lakh.

course_faqs.question: Is 80% in CAT enough for PGDM scholarship at Jaipuria Noida?
course_faqs.answer: Yes, students with 80% and above in CAT are eligible for a waiver of INR 3.50 Lacs at Jaipuria Institute of Management Noida. The total course fee for PGDM is INR 15.75 lakh. After waiver, students have to pay INR 12.25 Lacs as PGDM fee.

Jaipuria Institute of Management is approved by AICTE and AIU and accredited by NBA, with A Grade by NAAC, and AACSB. The college has been ranked 45th among the top Management institutes in India by NIRF 2024. Additionally, it has been ranked 36th among the top Private MBA colleges in India by IIRF 2023.

paragraphs: To start with the admission, students need to fill out the common application form. The application process to pursue a course for Noida campus comprises three phases. The student needs to complete all three phases of the application to qualify for the selection process.

reviews.review_heading: 2 Years of a Blissful Life at Jaipuria Institute.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and the infrastructure available for our course or department are Wi-Fi, Smart TV and AC in classrooms and also a very big library. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is decent and not that bad or very good, the food quality in the mess and the canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college to pursue PGDM.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is good. The hostel, classrooms, and library have a good Wi-Fi connection. Mess food quality is good. Medical facilities are good and a nurse is always available in our college. It has a good lawn to play many games. Classrooms are good.

reviews.review_heading: Joining here was my best decision.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are air-conditioned and well-furnished. The library has a lot of books, and we have a digital library also, which provides us access to various journals, magazines and newspapers. Good exposure and materials are offered.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaipuria Institute of Management, Noida.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good infrastructure. The library and cafeteria are the centers of attraction of the college. The college is spacious with lush green lawns. The college hostel is very big and clean and has all the amenities. The college also has an activity lounge and analytics lab.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaipuria Noida - Jaipuria Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The college has fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi-equipped classrooms, a playground, library, incubation center, labs, cafeteria, garden, and everything that is needed. Inside the campus, there is one girl's hostel with both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned rooms, a gym, a parlor, mess, medical facility, playroom, and laundry facilities. As of now, the boys' hostels are outside the campus, but the construction of the same inside campus has been started.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best institutions to gear up students' management education.
reviews.review_text: It provides a fully Wi-Fi-enabled campus and hostel premises. The computer laboratories and classrooms are also good including the projector's facilities. There is also enough space for ventilation in the classes. The quality of life including food, transport, the general nature of the staff, and sporting facilities are way beyond description and created a friendly atmosphere for the students to be at ease with the surroundings. All in all, it is a healthy environment best suited for management ...

reviews.review_heading: This college is good for placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is excellent and it has well-equipped air-conditioned classrooms with large projectors in every classroom. The college has a very good library facility which has almost 1,00,000 books and also has a sitting facility for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college to get acquainted with management skills. It is helpful.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. It has proper classrooms with a projector in each classroom. It has a huge library with a large sitting space, books, and magazines on every subject. There is a great canteen, which provides good and hygienic food items.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members in our college are qualified from IIMS and FMS.
reviews.review_text: The hostel has top infrastructure. Wi-Fi facility is also available in the hostel. The food served in the mess has the value for money. There is also a doctor available in the girls' hostel 24X7. A canteen is also available in the hostel and is available 24hrs.

reviews.review_heading: It is an average college because of teaching mode.
reviews.review_text: Our college doesn't provide many facilities, but the infrastructure of the classrooms and library are well-equipped. The facilities of the hostel are good as they provide all the necessities. They provide medical facilities and also a counselor. The quality of food served in the mess and canteen is average.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with Jaipuria Institute of Management, Noida .
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure provided by Jaipuria Institute of Management Noida include Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, library, canteen, hostel, garden, ground, and a students lounge. The quality of food served at the mess is fine, and it has prompt medical facilities and different sports and games for students.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is really good.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are really good, and we have hygienic facilities in our hostel. The canteen is good and has a healthy environment. Fresh and hygienic food is always available for us. We all feel really good.

reviews.review_heading: I am very well satisfied with the faculty members and college infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available on our campus, and they are good. The classrooms are spacious and air-conditioned. The campus is equipped with a 24x7 Wi-Fi facility, a 2-storeyed library with lots of books, 2 grounds, 1 canteen, badminton and basketball court and mess. Moreover, there are medical facilities, a gym, both indoor games and outdoor sports facilities, etc. Girls' hostel is available on the campus. The food served in the mess is good. Our college has followed all the Covid-19 protoco...

reviews.review_heading: I had an amazing experience with a lot of opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has excellent buildings, and all of them are in good working condition. All appliances are brand new and are very maintained. There are also green areas around the campus for students to enjoy. There is a need to add more classrooms and IT laboratories in our college. The classrooms are well-equipped and maintained. Living spaces are clean and well-maintained as per Covid-19 protocols.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi connection of our college is very good. We also have labs, air-conditioned classrooms, and a library. Our library is the most beautiful part of the college with a good place to sit and study. All types of books are available in the library. The hostel is very good and the quality of the food served is also very good.

paragraphs: Jaipuria Institute of Management Jaipur provides financial assistance to eligible and deserving students through scholarships. The college encourages meritorious students with several scholarships as it also enhances the college's diversity and enables them to enroll outstanding candidates from various backgrounds. Jaipuria Jaipur scholarships are provided to students under three categories, i.e. based on entrance exam scores, Sibling scholarship, and IDFC First Bank scholarship.
Category 1: The college accepts various entrance exam scores for admission to the PGDM programme.

Category 2: The college also offers a Sibling scholarship worth INR 1,00,000 to students. The scholarship will be awarded on a first come first served basis to a limited number of scholars subject to admission in PGDM/MBA courses. Category 3: Jaipuria Jaipur offers an IDFC First Bank MBA scholarship which is a need-based programme worth INR 2,00,000 for 2 years of full-time MBA programme. It is mainly designed for students who come from families with an annual income of less than INR 6 lakh.

faqs.question: Does GIM Goa provides waiver in fee?
faqs.answer: Yes, GIM Goa offer waiver in tuition fee. GIM Goa provides a tuition fee waiver scheme to students whose family income is less than INR 8 LPA to PGDM students. The tuition fee waiver is awarded to deserving students subject to a maximum of 5% of the students admitted. The facility of education loans is also available to students. The awardees would get a full waiver of the tuition fee. The award shall be based on the assessment of the financial need, considering total family income and economic condition of the family.

faqs.question: What is the fees of GIM Goa PGDM?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fees of PGDM course ranges between INR 5.3 lakh and INR 19.4 lakh . This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. Candidates who will qualify all the selection rounds for PGP admission will be required to pay the course to confirm their seat in the institute. In case, a candidates is unable to pay the fee within the specified time, his or her admission will stand cancelled. Candidates need to pay a application fee to apply for admission. The application fee ranges between INR 1,750 and INR 3,000 plus GST depending on the time of application for one or two courses. The fee increases, if a candidates applies for more than two courses.

review_content.Placements: In our college, placements are pretty good, but the competition is very high. Our college received so many admissions this year, which is nearly 50 thousand. There is a scope for our batch that we can get better placements if we work hard. For our course, there are low placements. In biotechnology, there are a few core jobs. If we need a well-paying job, then we need to work so hard.
review_content.Infrastructure: I can't say that the infrastructure is awesome. Our course blocks are clean and well-managed inside. The outside look is average. But the winning facilities are top grade. There is a Good Wi-Fi speed, which is nearly 10 GB per second, but in working hours, it is 2 to 3 GB per second. It is the same in the hostel as well.

reviews_list.batch_info: Integrated BBA + MBA - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: I’m strongly satisfied and worth it.

review_content.Placements: About 70-80%+ students were placed in recent batches of 24-25. The highest package is around 24-30 LPA, the lowest package is 3-4 LPA, and the average package is 12-13 LPA. Capgemini, Accenture, Wipro, TCS, Cognizant, ITC, Flipkart, HDFC, ICICI, DXC Technology, etc., recruited. 55-65% got internships in Decathlon, HUL, KPMG, Deloitte cognizant etc. Marketing analyst, financial analyst, Fintech, Digital analyst, Product manager, sales analyst, etc., roles are offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: 5G Wi-Fi, well-furnished classroom, benches with charging switch, AC, projector and whiteboards. Library with more than 10,000+ books, the latest computer labs, water supplies with a watercooler, garden with sitting benches, greenery flowers, food courts, terrace canteen, malls, sports complex. Hostel rooms are well-established rooms, AC, non-AC (cooler will be there), water cooler in every hostel floor, exercise machines are located in hostel premises, friendly warden, canteen in every hostel, departmental store, mess facilities also available, good food quality, everything is digitally run through UMS, LPU touch app. There are all types of playgrounds.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Best college with a good atmosphere and infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: Good placement, and above 80 percent of students get placed every year, according to the college. There are 100 percent placements with non-tech also, and Google, Microsoft, and IBM are the big companies that appear. The top roles in the robotics industry are offered with a package of 3 crore per annum, and the basic is 4 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: I'm from B.Tech CSE, and the infrastructure and Wi-Fi are fantastic. The classrooms are maintained very well. The library has a good number of books and a good place to study, and also a hostel is very good. All facilities are there, like games, indoor and outdoor. Good mess food, and there is a medical emergency like having a university hospital.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Placements are not up to the mark, huge opportunities available only if you study hard.

review_content.Placements: In my batch there were 100 students on average in campus placements for ECE. They got 20 to 30 people and that too at a very low package and they were not satisfied because if you got one opportunity, you had to take that, otherwise you would get terminated. The highest package in my batch was 8 LPA and the lowest package was 2.5 LPA. Top recruiters were LG, Wipro, Capegemini etc. Out of 100 students, 30 students got placed as Embedded Engineers, Software Engineers and VLSI Engineers etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and the hostel were very good. The hostel security is also good, various food will be served for north and south indians students, whatever they want but bit expensive for the hostel and food. The course and the labs were very good to use.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: LPU, choosing it is up to you.

review_content.Placements: Maximum people get placed in our college, the highest might go till crores. The highest went around 1 CPA and two are placed, one is from Robotics and Automation and the other is M. Tech guy. The lowest would be 3-4 LPA and most get placed through mass recruitment by companies averaging around 5-6 LPA. Companies include Google, TCS, Microsoft, Wipro and many, but the good companies hire the best students’ skills on upper preference as compared to GPA and the others hire Teach Mahindra, Eazy Diner, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are good, you get Wi-Fi facility at good speed in both college and hostel. Library is amazing, has a lot of books and even a good place to study; silence is a must. Classrooms are decent. Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms get cleaned often. Mess food might be good some days but will start to hate it. Canteen is good. College is really outstanding when it comes to sports. Inter-hostel tournaments happen. Olympic size swimming pool exists. Two big cricket grounds. Sports complex exists where you can play badminton, basketball, boxing, fencing, volleyball, and even martial arts.

admission_overview.college_name: LPU Admission 2026: Dates, Fees, Eligibility & Selection Criteria

admission_overview.title: LPU Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: LPU admission 2026 is mainly entrance-based and a multi-step process starting with application followed by selection rounds, and result declaration. The Lovely Professional University (LPU) offers more than 300 degree and diploma courses at the UG, PG, and doctoral levels along with several distance learning courses via the LPU Centre for Distance & Online Education. The application process for the university can be completed online. LPU conducts LPUNEST as the in-house entrance and scholarship exam for its courses in fileds of Engineering, Agriculture, Management, Law, Design, Pharmacy, Architecture & Planning, and more. While LPUNEST is widely accepted by the university, if students have valid scores of other national-level entrance exams, such JEE Main Part 2, NATA, CAT, MAT, XAT, etc, they are exempted from appearing for LPUNEST for selective courses. Those who want to improve their scholarships can apply for the LPUNEST exam as well.

eligibility_selection.title: LPU Eligibility & Selection Criteria 2026
eligibility_selection.description: Lovely Professional University course admissions are decided by the scores obtained by candidates in the Lovely Professional University National Entrance and Scholarship Test or LPUNEST for short for most courses. This entrance exam is conducted for admission to more than 150 courses at the UG and PG levels. A general eligibility for courses offered by Lovely Professional University is: In case a student has valid score in other accepted exams including JEE Main/ NATA/ CAT/ MAT, etc., they can directly proceed with the remaining selection rounds.

paragraphs: Lovely Professional University admission 2026can be completed online. Interested students can follow the steps given below to complete theLPU admission process:
1. LPU Application Process:Candidates have to register online LPU ADMIT with basic details. The application fee for LPUNEST is INR 1,000 for soft copy and INR 1500 for printed copy of LPUNEST Kit.
2.Depending on the programme, LPUNEST will have any one of the following purpose: Admission and Scholarship or only scholarship.

3.LPU also accepts JEE Main, CAT, MAT, CLAT, etc. to provide admission to BTech, MBA and law courses respectively.. For some of theLPU programmes, including MBA and PhD the university calls students for personal interview round.
4. After the announcement of the result, candidates need to select the programme for admission. LPU offers seats offered through both counselling and on a first-come-first-serve basis.

5.Students need to pay INR 10,000 as an initial fees once the provisional registration number is registered. All the specified documents need to be uploaded and the fees has to be paid within the give time line.

faqs.question: Will I get a direct admission in LPU with 65 % marks in Class 12?
faqs.answer: LPU does not offer direct admission. However, admission to few courses is merit-based.  Aspirants scoring a 65% aggregate have a good chance of getting admission in LPU. Candidates seeking admission must visit the official website of the university to apply online. To apply for LPU, aspirants need to register for LPUNEST for admission to undergraduate and postgraduate courses. LPU admission to most of the courses is based on LPUNEST score. However, national-level entrance exam scores are also accepted for admission to BA LLB (Hons), MBA, BTech, etc. Candidates must complete Class 12 for UG courses and graduation for PG courses. The selection rounds are followed by counselling and document verification.

faqs.question: Is LPU entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: LPUNEST is a national-level exam conducted by LPU for admission to various courses. LPUNEST forms the basis of eligibility for some programmes and also for the scholarship programmes. The amount of scholarship is determined by the marks and rank obtained by candidates in the exam. LPUNEST exam pattern elucidates the scheme of the question paper. Candidates seeking admission through LPUNEST must check the exam pattern prior to starting the preparation. LPUNEST exam pattern imparts details like total number of question, subjects, marking scheme, exam duration, etc. The entrance test is neither hard nor easy. Candidates must prepare well to score the qualifying marks in the entrance exam.

faqs.question: What would be the fees if you take a direct admission in the LPU?
faqs.answer: The fee is same for regular and direct admission. LPU fees changes for every course. The top LPU courses along with fee details are mentioned below:Course NameTotal FeeBTechINR 4.5 lakh - INR 16 lakhMBAINR 1.6 lakh - INR 10 lakhBBAINR 3.2 lakh - 9.6 lakhBCAINR 1.5 lakh - 7.2 lakhMCAINR 1.2 lakh - 4.8 lakhNote:This information is gathered from official website and is subject to change.

faqs.question: How can students get admission to LPU directly?
faqs.answer: LPU direct admissions are not possible for many courses. Students who wish to get admission must follow the application process given below:Register yourselfAppear for the LPUNEST exam.Once the results are announced, you have to choose a courseTake part in the counselling session and seat allotment.Perform well in the interview round.Fill the admission form and pay INR 10,000 initially.Submit all the necessary documents and pay the remaining fee.

placement_data.title: Lovely Professional University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The highest package offered during LPU placements 2025 stood at INR 2.5 crore per annum and the second highest package stood at INR 1.03 crore per annum. Both packages were offered to the students of BTech Robotics & Automation batch 2025. The average salary offered to the top 25% students stood at INR 10.23 LPA. More than 2,225 recruiters visited the LPU campus and offered over 6,000 job to the students. The top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Accenture, CISCO, TCS, Capgemini, Cognizant, Autodesk, Infosys, Trident, JP Morgan, E&Y, Bosch , etc.

Earlier, the students of the BTech batch 2024 secured the highest package of INR 53 LPA . A total of 1,611 recruiters participated in the placement process and prsented over 7,400 jobs to the students. Microsoft, Google, Infosys, L&T, Amazon, HCL, IBM, TCS, ICICI Bank, etc were among the top recruiters.

reviews.review_heading: It's all about your choice for this MBA course.
reviews.review_text: All the requirements are there. The tools needed to get it. Classrooms and labs have requirements. Wi-Fi is available on campus and in the hotel. The hotels are very good with facilities. The food in the mess is also very good. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LPU - Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: I can't say that the infrastructure is awesome. Our course blocks are clean and well-managed inside. The outside look is average. But the winning facilities are top grade. There is a Good Wi-Fi speed, which is nearly 10 GB per second, but in working hours, it is 2 to 3 GB per second. It is the same in the hostel as well.

reviews.review_heading: I’m strongly satisfied and worth it.
reviews.review_text: 5G Wi-Fi, well-furnished classroom, benches with charging switch, AC, projector and whiteboards. Library with more than 10,000+ books, the latest computer labs, water supplies with a watercooler, garden with sitting benches, greenery flowers, food courts, terrace canteen, malls, sports complex. Hostel rooms are well-established rooms, AC, non-AC (cooler will be there), water cooler in every hostel floor, exercise machines are located in hostel premises, friendly warden, canteen in every hostel, ...

reviews.review_heading: Best college with a good atmosphere and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: I'm from B.Tech CSE, and the infrastructure and Wi-Fi are fantastic. The classrooms are maintained very well. The library has a good number of books and a good place to study, and also a hostel is very good. All facilities are there, like games, indoor and outdoor. Good mess food, and there is a medical emergency like having a university hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are not up to the mark, huge opportunities available only if you study hard.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and the hostel were very good. The hostel security is also good, various food will be served for north and south indians students, whatever they want but bit expensive for the hostel and food. The course and the labs were very good to use.

reviews.review_heading: LPU, choosing it is up to you.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good, you get Wi-Fi facility at good speed in both college and hostel. Library is amazing, has a lot of books and even a good place to study; silence is a must. Classrooms are decent. Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms get cleaned often. Mess food might be good some days but will start to hate it. Canteen is good. College is really outstanding when it comes to sports. Inter-hostel tournaments happen. Olympic size swimming pool exists. Two big cricket grounds. Sports complex exists wher...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, good placements in 2022, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the university is in top-notch condition. This is the biggest university in India. All labs and library are well-equipped with air conditioning. Classrooms are well-maintained. Food is ok for South people, but it looks like somewhat difficult to survive on this food. They provide 24X7 medical facility.

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing facts about Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: For my course, the facilities are quite good. The university is providing computer labs, Wi-Fi and big classrooms. The library is also there, which is very huge and consists of a wide range of books. The hostel is also decent, and the rooms are always clean. Mess food is okay. Medical facilities are available at any time.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure and facilities. Good placements, campus life, and facilities are excellent.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of the classes are very good. Labs are also very good, and library facilities are excellent. Wi-Fi is good, but sometimes, due to the large number of students, the network goes down. Hostel facilities are very good. Mess food and canteen are also very good. Medical support is available 24x7. For sports, we have an auditorium where you can play games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: The best infrastructure this college has, alongwith very good placements.
reviews.review_text: On our campus, all facilities are very good. But sometimes we have Wi-Fi speed issues in some blocks, not in labs. The library is open from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM. Classrooms are digital for every class, we need a laptop mainly for CSE. Faculty are good. In the hostel, most of the facilities are very good, but a few times we have issues with the electricity bill at the end of the year. The gym is present inside the hostels, which is also free. The mess food is good in taste and unlimited. But the m...

reviews.review_heading: The college has beautiful infrastructure, good facilities, and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: The college had number one facilities and beautiful infrastructure. The classrooms for my course were hygienic and clean. Every block contained a library, and free Wi-Fi was available 24/7. The quality of food was not ideal for South Indian students. But overall, it was very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college with excellent infrastructure and strong placement support.
reviews.review_text: B.Tech, BBA, MBA, BCA, and MCA courses are offered. Labs are available, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in the hostel and college. The library is very good, with seven floors. Each floor can seat 100–120 students. Food is very good, and three types of food are available. South Indian, North Indian, and combined. Non-veg food is not allowed.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Lovely Institute of Technology, PharmacyReviewed on 17 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: You get placed according to your capacity and capabilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, smart classes, libraries, and even a hospital inside the campus. The campus is even bigger and has its own many areas and food courts. It has many facilities, like an indoor stadium, a pool, many grounds, and even a helipad for helicopter landing.

reviews.review_heading: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Amazed with the college infrastructure as they were offering a number of courses in various sections. For all the sections, 80 percent of seats were enrolled directly and the rest of the enrollment was through management. Fees should vary between direct admission and management quota students. Sports and games were played by us regularly as they were part of our schedule.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LPU  Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: Visiting the hostel rooms seriously made me feel comfortable and much more peaceful in the day to day routine. The perfect environment allowed us to have meaningful college days without any distractions. The fee fixed for all the services was not affordable to all.

reviews_list.review_title: My personal review on ICFAI.

review_content.Placements: If you are here for placements, this college may not be for you. They have good starter companies that come to the college and offer fundamental salary packages. A few did get a placement from very good companies and even local companies with good CTC for everyone with good talent and benefited the college. It is very well furnished inside and outside with full plants.
review_content.Infrastructure: Well furnished and well constructed, there are a total of 3 buildings or blocks for B.Tech, BBA, and MBA. Every building and their infrastructure are very well developed and constructed. There are many canteens and even pavements to walk from one stop to another. There are street lights and many path boards.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) (Hons.) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: In general about the college

review_content.Placements: Mostly students join here for higher studies, so don’t expect much placements. Placements are around 50 percent with an average package of 5 LPA. Regarding the top recruiting companies, you can check the website. Accenture, Amazon, Deloitte, HDFC Bank, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini, ICICI Bank, and ITC are the top recruiters. Getting an internship is compulsory as part of the curriculum. They basically need a certificate and proof for the same.
review_content.Infrastructure: It’s a big college with good infrastructure. We have well-equipped labs and Wi-Fi everywhere. No compromises on infrastructure here. The library is good with a decent number of books. The canteen food is nice and offers a variety of options. There are many grounds for different sports, so you can play anytime.

facilities: ICFAI Hyderabad hostel facilities provide occupancy for around 3000+ students through separate hostel facilities for boys and girls. It is well-staffed with wardens and security to facilitate the students. The campus has recreational facilities such as a gym and several other basic amenities.

IFHE Hyderabad campus has lecture theatres and smart classrooms that equip any learning experience with much more advancement. It has a central library which is IT infrastructure supported with a collection of around 70K+ documents and is open for 15 hours a day. It is equipped with the latest national and international editions of journals, research papers/reports and reads. ICFAI Hyderabad campus has access to various academic databases that hold subscriptions to around 5000+ national and international journals through the database. Apart from a central library, the IFHE campus also owns separate libraries for the Faculty of Science and Technology and the Faculty of Law.

The campus has indoor and outdoor sports such as Badminton, TT, Squash, Tennis, Football, Cricket, Basketball and Swimming. IFHE owns an experienced and highly driven sports faculty that prepares athletes for national-level matches and conducts events like sports fests.

faqs.answer: A:    For the full MBA programme at LM Thapar School of Management (LMTSM), tuition, examination fees, library fees, and registration fees total about INR 8–9 lakhs. The cost of the MBA programme in Big Data and Business Analytics is approximately INR 8.99 lakhs. Without housing costs, the cost of the PhD Executive programme at LMTSM is approximately INR 98,000 per semester. faqs.question: What are the fees for MBA programmes at LM Thapar School of Management?
faqs.answer: For the full MBA programme at LM Thapar School of Management (LMTSM), tuition, examination fees, library fees, and registration fees total about INR 8–9 lakhs. The cost of the MBA programme in Big Data and Business Analytics is approximately INR 8.99 lakhs. Without housing costs, the cost of the PhD Executive programme at LMTSM is approximately INR 98,000 per semester. Separate costs apply to the hostel: INR 21,500 for dorm rooms and an extra INR 7,900 for air-conditioned rooms per semester. For hostelers, the mess fees are INR 15,000, while for day scholars, they are INR 5,000. The cost of the MBA programme is extremely low when compared to other universities offering business courses.

faqs.question: How costly is LM Thapar School of Management?
faqs.answer: The Chandigarh-based LM Thapar School of Management charges an average of INR 5,10,700 per year for its twelve courses. The MBA programme costs about INR 8 to 9 Lacs in total tuition. For non-AC rooms, the cost of the hostel is INR 21,500 per semester, while for AC rooms, it is INR 29,400. For hostelers, the mess fees are INR 15,000, while for day scholars, they are INR 5,000. One of the colleges that offers a dual degree is Thapar, and the course curriculum is adaptable. Student exchange programs are supported by the campus. 'Sustainability in practice' is an additional course offered by LM Thapar that exposes students to real-world projects, homework, and other group activities.

placement_data.title: IIT Dhanbad Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: A total of 1,687 students registered and 1,335 students participated and 1072 students were placed during IIT Dhanbad placement 2025 . A total of 976 domestic offers and 27 international offers were made in the year 2025. The average and median packages offered were INR 17.53 LPA and INR 13.38 LPA , respectively.

242 PPOs were received and 216 PPOs were accepted during the placement drive 2025. A total of 279 job offers made were above INR 20 LPA . 400 offers were made with salary package between 10 LPA and 20 LPA. Job offers between 6 LPA and 10 LPA were 367. A total of 26 companies didn’t disclose the CTC offered to students in 2025.

sports.description: IIT Dhanbad boasts a comprehensive and well-maintained array of sports and recreational amenities under its Sports & Physical Education Centre (SPEC) and Student Activity Centre (SAC):

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for mining and petroleum engineering courses.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. The hostel is not that good in terms of food and other facilities. Hostels are not very flexible in entry and exit timings. Labs are good. The library is a very good place.

reviews.review_heading: Really enjoyable and a great place to study while exploring the campus and curriculum.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure might look old, but it is strong since it was built in 1926 during the British period. The auditorium has good capacity. Classrooms are equipped with central AC and smart boards. The library is much bigger than expected. They provide an excellent study environment.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for students' studies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this course is very good for students. Many facilities are provided by this university, such as a 24-hour Wi-Fi facility for students and faculty members. Our university has many big libraries for students where they learn and study together. The university classrooms are very big and fully air-conditioned. This university also has many hostels for students. The food quality is also very good in the canteen and hostel.

reviews.review_heading: The campus has a classic environment, well-trained faculty, and good placements every year.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are good in terms of academics, like labs, Wi-Fi, classrooms, and branchwise departments. The campus environment is very nice, with lots of trees. It has a pollution-free campus, as most vehicles run on electricity. Hostels are also nice. We get both good non-vegetarian and vegetarian food. Sports and games are excellent here. All required courts are available here. We also have a student activity centre where we play indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.
reviews.review_text: Campus Wi‑Fi is available free of cost and for unlimited use. Labs are equipped with computers, although some systems are old. Classrooms are air-conditioned and very spacious. The best thing about our college is its 7‑storey library containing thousands of books, with ample sitting areas and a cafeteria. Hostels are small. The mess/food is the greatest downside. Currently, our sports grounds are under renovation, so sports aren’t active lately.

reviews.review_heading: A brief overview of college life at IIT Dhanbad.
reviews.review_text: There are many hostels on campus for student accommodation. Each hostel provides all basic necessities like 24/7 cold/hot water, Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and a canteen. Hostel food is also nice and hygienic. Labs have advanced computer facilities with Wi-Fi. Classrooms are air-conditioned. We have one of the largest libraries in Asia.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with top faculty, strong labs, good facilities, and excellent placements.
reviews.review_text: As I was studying at IIT, the food quality was good, but as I was from the South, I did suffer; mostly people from the South will suffer. Wi-Fi is 24/7 available in the hostel, college, and library. Classrooms have digital boards and are provided with projectors, and everything is facilitated with air conditioning.

reviews.review_heading: Great opportunities, mixed hostel vibes, but worth it for the IIT tag.
reviews.review_text: I am part of the 2K21-25 batch, and overall, the infrastructure is decent. Classrooms are well-maintained, Wi-Fi is available but patchy at times, and labs have the necessary equipment, though some need upgrades. The library is huge. Hostel life was manageable. Rooms were okay, but not luxurious. Mess food is hit or miss. Some days are edible, some days are emotional damage. The canteen has better options, and the sports facilities are actually good. Medical facilities are available, but basic. ...

reviews.review_heading: Decent college, but with some fundamental problems.
reviews.review_text: Our mechanical department is the richest in the entire college. We have a lot of machines and lab equipment. We have the Institute Research Hub (iRh) and the innovation centre i2H and NVCTI. They have world-class infrastructure. However, I have only given three stars for the infrastructure, which is because of the hostel. The food is okay, we get paneer and non-veg 3 times a week, and the taste is okay. The internet speed is only 50 Mbps most of the time, and the rooms are small and don't even h...

reviews.review_heading: Extremely happy seeing my dream of becoming an IITan come true.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good. We are getting several facilities with computer labs, a Library, and Many lecture halls for studying. The full campus is Wi-Fi covered, and internet LAN cables are also available everywhere.  Inside the hostel, on every floor, a common room is also available for playing games, watching TV, and relaxing.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best university in Dhanbad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this course is very good for the students. There are many facilities available in this university, like all-time Wi-Fi. There is a big library present in this university where students learn together. There is a big hostel with a calm and clean environment for the students. The food quality is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best college in Jharkhand.
reviews.review_text: IIT Dhanbad has a large 444.98-acre campus with a fully automated, extensive library, spacious smart board-equipped classrooms, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Student amenities include 24/7 healthcare, sports facilities like a swimming pool and gymnasium, and the student canteen offers spacious twin-sharing rooms with high-speed internet. This university is very good in all its facilities. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: Best IIT for opting for core fields.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my branch is average, not good like other IITs. Basic classrooms without a projector, Wi-Fi enabled campus, but with low speed. The library of this college is very big and has a large number of books. Hostel facilities are average, the canteen and mess food are not good in taste, but you can manage it. Medical and sports facilities are good, and students get opportunities to show their talent.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: There are 6 hostels for males and 2 for females. All the hostels are good, but I love Diamond Hostel because of the heritage it has. The rooms are spacious, and you need to share the room with one person. The hostel fees are included in your semester registration. The course curriculum is pretty good. It is well-structured and helps the students in getting a better understanding of the entire field.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: There are 6 hostels for males and 2 for females. All hostels are good but I love Diamond Hostel because of the heritage it has. Rooms are spacious and we need to share the room with one person. The hostel fee is included in our semester registration.

review_content.Placements: Placements are usually good at Amity University. Good recruiting companies come to our college for placements, and high packages are provided. In some cases, when the placements are not provided, the students can also find job opportunities outside also.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is too good. For my course, the building is a little underdeveloped, but it is soon going to be developed as promised by the faculty. Food, medicine, and sports facilities are really good in this university. The hostel is also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Engineering at Amity University, Noida, is effective and it only has the fame.

review_content.Placements: I would like to say that approximately 75 percent of students got the placements. If they are well prepared with the skills required in current technology. There are lots of companies visiting the campus for placement. If you have good skills, you can get a placement easily. There are many roles, such as GET, Software Engineer, and sales, also.
review_content.Infrastructure: If I talk about Amity, the best thing that they are providing is the infrastructure, the campus is fully AC and fully Wi-Fi-enabled. They have a good number of labs for practicals in the Computer Science subject. They have a special AI lab which has been built in collaboration with NVIDIA. In my college, there are a number of canteens and cafeterias. From then on, the best one is the Mega Bite named canteen.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It has good infrastructure and a good course curriculum.

review_content.Placements: Around 35% of students from our course get placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered is 8 LPA, reflecting strong technical roles. The lowest package is 1 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell and Coforge, which hire students for technical support roles. Approximately 70 percent of students secure internships. The most common role offered is IT technician.
review_content.Infrastructure: The department has well-maintained infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. It has properly equipped computer labs, and a well-stocked library that supports academic learning. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms. It also has decent mess and canteen food. Along with adequate medical support, and access to sports facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Average opinion about the college.

review_content.Placements: Out of 11 students interested in placements, 3 have been successfully placed through campus placements. The highest package till now is 7.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course include BSES, Vanderlande, Schlumberger, Kirloskar Oil Engines, and LiuGong. 50 percent of students got internships through college support in companies like Dixon Technologies Ltd. and Nuremberg Ltd. Top roles offered include graduate engineer trainee and associate sales engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are well-equipped with all the necessary infrastructure and machines. Classrooms are a bit messy. The library is well-equipped with good infrastructure and books. I found the mess quite hygienic, but the taste of the food is not up to the mark. Sports facilities and grounds are average, with nothing special.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Pharm. in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Great campus and teachers but dissatisfied with labs and placements.

review_content.Placements: The average package of 3 LPA can be expected. Only one company comes here that offers 8 LPA, but it takes 2 to 3 students only rest all are placed at the above mentioned package. The company comes, and you will give interview and sometimes they are online as well.
review_content.Infrastructure: Amity is best in terms of infrastructure, classrooms and library but lab in the pharmacy department definitely needs an upgrade. They are really good in other departments like biotechnology or chemistry, etc. The classroom teaching takes place with a projector and ppts are provided as notes. Hostels are available but the cost is very high and food is not included in the hostel fee and rooms are small as well.

reviews_list.review_title: My college's placement section must be improved.

review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, grounds, washrooms, etc. Facilities are very good according to the fees taken from students.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers of my course are very cooperative towards their students. Semester examinations are not that difficult for regular students of my college.

review_summary.college_name: Amity University Noida UP Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Clinical Psychology (Honours / Research) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied because of the campus life, faculty, and services given by this university.

content.Placements: Placements are usually good at Amity University. Good recruiting companies come to our college for placements, and high packages are provided. In some cases, when the placements are not provided, the students can also find job opportunities outside also.
content.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is too good. For my course, the building is a little underdeveloped, but it is soon going to be developed as promised by the faculty. Food, medicine, and sports facilities are really good in this university. The hostel is also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Engineering at Amity University, Noida, is effective and it only has the fame.

content.Placements: I would like to say that approximately 75 percent of students got the placements. If they are well prepared with the skills required in current technology. There are lots of companies visiting the campus for placement. If you have good skills, you can get a placement easily. There are many roles, such as GET, Software Engineer, and sales, also.
content.Infrastructure: If I talk about Amity, the best thing that they are providing is the infrastructure, the campus is fully AC and fully Wi-Fi-enabled. They have a good number of labs for practicals in the Computer Science subject. They have a special AI lab which has been built in collaboration with NVIDIA. In my college, there are a number of canteens and cafeterias. From then on, the best one is the Mega Bite named canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and a good course curriculum.

content.Placements: Around 35% of students from our course get placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered is 8 LPA, reflecting strong technical roles. The lowest package is 1 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell and Coforge, which hire students for technical support roles. Approximately 70 percent of students secure internships. The most common role offered is IT technician.
content.Infrastructure: The department has well-maintained infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. It has properly equipped computer labs, and a well-stocked library that supports academic learning. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms. It also has decent mess and canteen food. Along with adequate medical support, and access to sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Average opinion about the college.

content.Placements: Out of 11 students interested in placements, 3 have been successfully placed through campus placements. The highest package till now is 7.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course include BSES, Vanderlande, Schlumberger, Kirloskar Oil Engines, and LiuGong. 50 percent of students got internships through college support in companies like Dixon Technologies Ltd. and Nuremberg Ltd. Top roles offered include graduate engineer trainee and associate sales engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are well-equipped with all the necessary infrastructure and machines. Classrooms are a bit messy. The library is well-equipped with good infrastructure and books. I found the mess quite hygienic, but the taste of the food is not up to the mark. Sports facilities and grounds are average, with nothing special.

individual_reviews.course: M.Pharm. in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great campus and teachers but dissatisfied with labs and placements.

content.Placements: The average package of 3 LPA can be expected. Only one company comes here that offers 8 LPA, but it takes 2 to 3 students only rest all are placed at the above mentioned package. The company comes, and you will give interview and sometimes they are online as well.
content.Infrastructure: Amity is best in terms of infrastructure, classrooms and library but lab in the pharmacy department definitely needs an upgrade. They are really good in other departments like biotechnology or chemistry, etc. The classroom teaching takes place with a projector and ppts are provided as notes. Hostels are available but the cost is very high and food is not included in the hostel fee and rooms are small as well.

paragraphs: Amity Noida admissionis a multi-step process. Candidates seeking for getting admission to UG/ PG courses of the university must go through a detailedAmity University Noida admission process. To admit the right candidates, the university selects students based on selection criteria, which include filling theAmity Noida application form, qualifying for the selection rounds and paying for theAmity University Noida feesat the time of final admission.
Interested in Amity University Noida course admissions? Check out the elaborated steps for theAmity University admission processin the following section:

The Amity University admission process begins by filling an application form on the official website of Amity University Noida. If candidates wish to apply for more than one programme, they need to fill out a separate form for each course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,500each. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity Noida.

Amity Noida admissions are both merit and entrance-based depending on the course. Students need to meet clear both criteria to get admission. The selection criteria for Amity Noida programmes are as below:

review_summary.college_name: Great Lakes Gurgaon Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: 2023-2025 batch experience.

content.Placements: A great college for MBA, the CCS team (the placement team) make sure everyone gets placed. All students from our seniors batch are placed and our placement is still going on. The CTC is between 8 LPA to 20 LPA, and an average of 13 LPA. Big companies like Deloitte, KPMG, Accenture, EY, Bank of America hire from our batch. Most students intern with top brands like KPMG, CRISIL, Jaguar, and Deloitte, gaining valuable experience.
content.Infrastructure: Excellent facilities with 24/7 AC and high-speed Wi-Fi across all the campus. The mess, managed by Sodexo, provides some of the best food among hostels, with a night canteen open until 2:45 am, and the paneer paratha is everyone’s favorite on the menu. The campus has a well-stocked library, and a new cafe for quick bites. For sports, there are separate grounds for football, basketball, cricket, and badminton courts. Medical facilities are available on campus, ensuring health support whenever needed.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Holds the best faculty team with good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: The placement is from top-notch companies with an average package of 12 LPA, and everyone is given a fair chance. Top recruiting companies are Gartner, KPMG, Deloitte, etc. Internship and placement go hand in hand with the same recruiting companies and a maximum stipend of 85k.
content.Infrastructure: There is 24/7 Wi-Fi everywhere on campus. The classrooms are well adjusted with an all-time open library and the best books inside. Food and room are both hygienic and filled with varation and all time cruines. Washrooms are common but well maintained. There is even an all-time-available medical facility and doctor on campus.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Dynamic Campus, Diverse Opportunities.

content.Placements: The placement process at Great Lakes Institute of Management, Gurgaon, is structured and competitive, aimed at securing roles in various sectors including Consulting, BFSI, Analytics, Marketing and Advertising, Automobile, IT/ITES, and Internet Business. For the 2024 pass-out batch, the average CTC was 11.7 LPA, with the highest package reaching 22.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is rich and green, featuring modern facilities for both academic and residential needs. The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled, with both outdoor and indoor sports facilities available. There are courts for basketball and badminton, as well as provisions for indoor games like table tennis. The hostels are modern, well-maintained, and equipped with basic amenities like beds, study tables, almirahs, and chairs. Rooms are air-conditioned, and housekeeping services are provided regularly.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely wholesome learning and campus experience in 2019.

content.Placements: Placements support was extensive during my batch. The CCS team conducted rigorous placement preparation with mock interviews, GDs, guesstimates, etc., which were standard for recruitment processes. The average CTC for my 2019 batch was 11.2 LPA, with the highest hitting 17 LPA. All my batchmates were placed by the end of the programme. As per recent placement statistics, the campus has come a long way in just 5 years.
content.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure and hostels are state-of-the-art. A fully Wi-Fi-equipped air-conditioned campus with ample open space and greenery provides a comfortable and conducive learning environment to spend a lot of productive time with peers. Classrooms are modern auditorium-style to enable the best faculty-student interactions. Food quality is far better than most hostels in the country.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: One of the best in all aspects!

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed from the previous batch was 100%. Some of the top recruiters consist of Deloitte, KPMG, Vedanta, EY, Axtria, Berkadia, BOA, Gartner, and Infosys. Some of the top roles were Senior Analyst, Team Lead, Financial Analyst, and Consultant. The highest package was 21 LPA, the median package was 10 LPA, and the lowest package was 9 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms have top-of-the-line technology for ease of teaching, and the library is open 24/7 for the students. The whole campus has very smooth and fast Wi-Fi, and the classrooms have provisions for online guest lectures from different industry experts from different countries. The hostel is twin sharing with adequate space in the room and is fully air-conditioned. The canteen is open until 3 AM, and the food quality is good as it is managed by Sodexo. There is a 24/7 medical facility with full support for emergencies, ambulance services, and a psychiatrist available for the mental health well-being of the students. There are football grounds, a volleyball court, badminton courts, and a basketball court for sports activities.

A fully Wi-Fi-equipped air-conditioned campus with ample open space and greenery provides a comfortable and conducive learning environment to spend a lot of productive time with peers. Classrooms are modern auditorium-style to enable the best faculty-student interactions. Food quality is far better than most hostels in the country.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best in all aspects!
reviews.review_text: The classrooms have top-of-the-line technology for ease of teaching, and the library is open 24/7 for the students. The whole campus has very smooth and fast Wi-Fi, and the classrooms have provisions for online guest lectures from different industry experts from different countries. The hostel is twin sharing with adequate space in the room and is fully air-conditioned. The canteen is open until 3 AM, and the food quality is good as it is managed by Sodexo. There is a 24/7 medical facility with ...

reviews.review_heading: Great Lakes provides exceptional faculty, strong placements opportunities, and vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: The campus is beautiful, clean, and surrounded by greenery. It features two academic buildings and four hostels, spacious classrooms, a fantastic library, and comprehensive sports facilities, including a gym. With centralized AC, Wi-Fi, good-quality food, and 24-hour medical support, it provides a comfortable and well-rounded environment for both living and learning.

reviews.review_heading: Great Lakes Institute of Management: A Center of Excellence.
reviews.review_text: The best part about this college for me personally is the 24/7 open library and gym. Apart from these, the college also has XR Lab, high-speed Wi-Fi available for students everywhere in each building in every room, and smart lecture rooms. When it comes to living, the hostel facilities are very well maintained, neat, and provide more than expected perks for a college hostel that one would've normally expected. We have AC hostel rooms with twin sharing for all the students. Multiple cafeterias/me...

reviews.review_heading: Budding B-school in NCR region .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at Great Lakes is amazing. Lush green campus with modern infrastructure makes it sustainability-focused. Classes are well-equipped with the latest technology to enhance the learning. We have a library that is accessible 24/7 and provides a plethora of books to read. The college has an in-house IT team providing IT and Wi-Fi support across the campus. Won't be doing justice if doesn't appreciate the Sodexo catering for food and housekeeping services.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the Great Lakes experience. Salute to the commendable efforts of Placement Team.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided were top-notch, be it classrooms, hostels, library, mess, or cafeteria. The college had centralized ACs, and Wi-Fi connectivity was provided all over the college as well as the hostel. Food was available in four meals, and that too in good variety and nice quality, better than many colleges. Sports and medical facilities were also available, with 24-hour doctor support.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with everything .
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure. Neat and clean room to live in. Good campus to live in. Not too big but enough space to have fun. Good classrooms and big enough to study. Library is fabulous. Neat and clean canteen. Good environment. We have meeting rooms to do group activities.

reviews.review_heading: Good emerging college and excellent faculty.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well maintained. The library is well-equipped with books related to the curriculum as well as other reading materials. Hostels are also well maintained. Everything is managed by Sodexo including the mess and canteen. We have a food truck which opens till 3 am.

reviews.review_heading: Highly qualified and connected faculty. The campus could have been a bit bigger.
reviews.review_text: If we are talking about the infrastructure, it is really good. The campus though is small, merely 6 or 7 acres but the infrastructure is compensated for that. Classrooms are modern and decorative with smart equipments. Wi-Fi is available all the time and its speed is also very good. The library is good too with all management books available. The campus could have been a bit bigger.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Great Lakes Institute of Management, Gurgaon.
reviews.review_text: The campus was good enough to contain 500 students. There are common washrooms in the hostel, which was an issue. They charge 1.4 LPA, but cannot provide separate washrooms. The college provides a twin sharing room with the air-conditioned facility and with all the amenities. The library is good and huge enough to accommodate 100 students at a time.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, professors and hospitality with good ROI.
reviews.review_text: Our college has excellent infrastructure with 3 hostel buildings and 2 academic blocks. It has a well-equipped computer lab and a library. Mess and hospitality services are handled by Sodexo who provide state-of-the-art facilities like clean washrooms and housekeeping.

reviews.review_heading: Great College with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: College has the best facilities available like Wi-Fi enabled campus, fully air conditioned classrooms and hostel rooms,  24 hours availability of electricity and water facilities. Large mess to accommodate 100 people at a time. Other amenities like Medical room, sports equipment, Emergency Van are also available at campus.

fees_and_eligibility.overview:
Candidates willing to get admission must take part in the IIM Sirmaur admission process before the last date of application. IIM Sirmaur fees (application) must be paid timely and candidates must know the IIM Sirmaur eligibility criteria before applying online. At the PG level, the college provides a two-year full-time residential MBA course to students. The college also offers an Executive MBA and various other courses to students.

Aspirats can also pursue PhD from IIM Sirmaur, if they meet the basic eligibility criteria. PhD (FPM) programme is a full-time residential course available for a duration of five years. Below mentioned are some of the courses offered by IIM Sirmaur and their respective eligibility and IIM Sirmaur fee structure:

faqs.answer: A:    Candidates need to pass a master's degree in any discipline with at least 60% aggregate or a two-year PG diploma with at least 60% marks along with a bachelor's degre with at least 50% aggregate to apply for IIM Sirmaur PhD course. Aspirants who have passed a five-year integrated master's degree with at least 60% in any discipline or a professional qualification like CA, ICWA, CS with at least 50% along with a bachelor's degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate can also apply.
faqs.question: What is the eligibility for Ph.D at IIM Sirmaur?

faqs.answer: A:    The minimum CAT percentile required for both overall and section-wise categories for admission to the MBA programme at IIM Sirmaur was 90 which was in the cutoff list released by IIM Sirmaur for the year 2024. Candidates seeking admission to the MBA programme at IIM Sirmaur must prepare well for the CAT exam and need to score accordingly. Here are a few CAT exam preparation tips:Check the CAT syllabus and the pattern of the exam.Selection of the right reference books following the emerging CAT exam pattern.Try to solve the maximum number of CAT Mock Tests. Download FREE practice questions and answers!Solve CAT exam PYQs for thorough revision and to clear all the important concepts.
faqs.question: How much percentile is required for IIM Sirmaur MBA?

faqs.answer: A:    The process of getting into IIM Sirmaur is through the CAT examination and hence there are no reservation criteria exclusively. The usual reservation criteria that are associated with the CAT examination are the only ones that the college follows. These reservations include the SC, ST, OBC, etc. On the contrary there can be some other advantages if you belong to the same state or if you are a girl child etc. There are no other reservations apart from what the Indian Government has prescribed.
faqs.question: Are there any seat reservations at IIM Sirmaur?

faqs.answer: A:    No, IIM Sirmaur only accepts admission to its MBA programme based on the CAT (Common Admission Test) examination. CAT scores are the primary basis for shortlisting candidates for the Personal Interview (PI) round. GMAT or GRE is not used for admission to the MBA programme at IIM Sirmaur. But if you wish admission to the PhD programme, IIM Sirmaur accepts CAT, GATE, GMAT, GRE, or UGC-JRF scores.

review_content.Placements: Being one of the premium institutes of India, IIM Sirmaur performed excellently in the final placement of 2020 with a hike of 62% in the highest package as compare to the placements of 2019. Amidst the COVID-19 situation, the institute successfully facilitated placement to 94% of the batch and gave extended placement support to the student who couldn't participate in the final placement due to the coronavirus outbreak. The highest CTC touched 26 LPA and the figure of the average package of the top 25% of the batch turned out to be exceptionally remarkable with 16.40 LPA. In the final placement, the batch had four international placements and 3 PPOs with an increase of 16.67% in the median CTC, and the average package of the batch closed around 11.28 LPA. The institute catered to more than 75 companies of the various sector in the final placement of 2020, which includes ICICI, HDFC, BYJU'S, Tech Mahindra, Muthoot Fincorp, DCM Shriram, Lenskart, JS associates, Kent Healthcare, etc. The top sectors that fetched the placement for the majority of students were BFSI with 23%, Edtech with 20%, Manufacturing with 12%, and Technology with 11%. The roles offered to the students were predominately Project Manager, Business Developer, Consultant, and Business Analyst.

paragraphs: IIM Sirmaur admissionsare entirely based on entrance examinations. The institute offers PG & doctoral-level programmes in the field of Management. Candidates wanting to apply forIIM Sirmaur course admissioncan take the CAT examination for MBA & GATE/CAT for PhD courses. TheIIM Sirmaurapplication process takes place in online mode. Aspirants applying for the MBA course can apply for the CAT examination. The complete details about the offered courses and admissions are provided in the following sections.

IIM Sirmaur admission is offered to PG and doctoral-level programmes in the field of management. Here are the details for most opted courses at IIM Sirmaur along with their eligibility and selection process.
UG degree in any discipline with a minimum of 50% aggregate (45% for reserved categories)
A valid PG degree with a minimum of 55% aggregate

IIM Sirmaur feeis cumulative of multiple components, such as tuition fee, security deposit, hostel fee, mess fee, and more. Some of these components are one-time chargeable such as the security deposit. The other fee components could be refundable, non-refundable, to be paid semester-wise or annually. Moreover, the institute follows the reservation policy as prescribed by the Government of India. Mentioned below are the fee and seat details for theIIM Sirmaur courses:
NOTE:The above-mentioned fee and seat intake are as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is however subject to changes and hence, is indicative.
IIM Sirmaur seat intake varies course-wise. Candidates can get a seat in the institute based on their entrance exam scores. Below is the course-wise intake:
Note:This info. is taken from the official website/ sanctioning body and can change anytime.

Sirmaur IIM admissionhas various steps. It involves application form filling, the cutoff list release, selection rounds, seat allotment, & also confirmation of the admission. Before the application for admission, aspirants are advised to check the eligibility criteria. The process is explained below step-wise in detail:

Candidates wishing to get admission to the most opted MBA programme of IIM Sirmaur can take the CAT examination. CAT form can be filled by candidates by paying the application fee of INR 2,400 (UR candidates) & INR 1,200 (reserved category). For PhD admission, students can apply through IIM Sirmaur's official site by paying the registration fees of INR 1,000 (1 specialisation) & INR 1,500 (2 specialisations).

The selection criteria for admission to the MBA is completely entrance-based candidates having valid CAT scores will be shortlisted for the Personal Interview (PI) round. In addition to this, candidates seeking admission to the PhD programme must have a valid test score of CAT/ GMAT/ GATE/ GRE/ UGC-JRF. IIM Sirmaur shortlists candidates for the doctoral programme based on their scores in CAT/ GMAT/ GATE/ GRE/ UGC-JRF for the Personal Interview (PI) round.

For admission to the MBA offered at IIM Sirmaur, candidates should have valid CAT scores and must qualify for the personal interview (PI) round followed by document verification and fee payment to complete the admission process leading to final seat allotment. Also, for admission to the PhD programme CAT/ GMAT/ GATE/ GRE/ UGC-JRF score will be shortlisted for the Personal Interview (PI) round and those who qualify for the PI round will be given offer letters of admission to the Doctoral Programme at IIM Sirmaur. Selected candidates need to pay theIIM Sirmaur feeto confirm their seat in the institute.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for Ph.D at IIM Sirmaur?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to pass a master's degree in any discipline with at least 60% aggregate or a two-year PG diploma with at least 60% marks along with a bachelor's degre with at least 50% aggregate to apply for IIM Sirmaur PhD course. Aspirants who have passed a five-year integrated master's degree with at least 60% in any discipline or a professional qualification like CA, ICWA, CS with at least 50% along with a bachelor's degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate can also apply.

faqs.question: Is SOP required for Ph.D admission at IIM Sirmaur?
faqs.answer: Yes, PhD students need to submit a statement of purpose reflecting their research interest. The SOP should mention the background of the student, motivation of the aspirants to pursue research, area of research of their interest and any details that aspirant does not mention in the application form.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to Ph.D at IIM Sirmaur?
faqs.answer: IIM Sirmaur shortlists candidates for PhD programme based on GMAT, GRE, CAT, GATE or JRF (NET) scores. Aspirants also need to submit a statement of purpose and research proposal. Selected candidates are further called for a personal interview round for PhD admission.

faqs.question: Is it hard to get into IIM Sirmaur?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the MBA programme at IIM Sirmaur must meet the overall and section-wise CAT percentile. placement_data.title: IIM Sirmaur Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The overall average package received during IIM SIrmaur placement 2025 was INR 13.3 LPA . The average package received by Male and Female students stood at INR 13.7 and INR 12.4 LPA, respectively. Around 70% of the recruiters that hired in the previous placement season visited the campus this year as well .

IIM Sirmaur MBA batch of 2023-25 comprised 295 students . Students from Science and Engineering background formed 38% of the batch whereas 31% students from Commerce background. Students from Management, Arts and Medicine academic streams constituted 22%, 7%, 1% of the batch. The MBA batch of 2025 comprised majorly fresher student and 64 out of the 295 students reported prior work experience .

Diverse Sector-Wise Placement: Leading recruiters across diverse sectors such as Con sulting, BFSI, FMCG, EdTech and Manufacturing visited the campus during IIM Sirmaur placement 2025 for the MBA program. More than 250 new recruiters visited the campus during IIM Sirmaur MBA placements 2025.
Top Recruiters: Ernst & Young, PwC, PhonePe, ICICI Bank, Accenture, Axis Bank

A total of 202 companies visited the campus during IIM Sirmaur MBA summer placements 2025 for the batch of 2024-26. The overall average stipend received this year stood at INR 54,950 . The top 50% of the batch received average package of INR 81,829 .

Earlier, IIM Sirmaur released its placement report 2024 for MBA and MBA Tourism & Hospitality Management programs . IIM Sirmaur placement report focuses on the placement outcomes across different courses . It highlights the placement trends in the context of work experience , industry preferences and growing competitiveness of various students’ cohorts .

According to the placement 2024, a total of 298 students enrolled for placements across MBA and MBA T&HM programs, and secured 325 opportunities during IIM Sirmaur placements 2025. Further, the overall highest and average package received by students’ during IIM Sirmaur placements 2024 was INR 32.65 LPA and INR 13.80 LPA , respectively. The average package received from sectors such as Investment Banking , E-Commerce and Manufacturing stood at INR 26.5 LPA , INR 21.71 LPA and INR 17.18 LPA in 2024.
Banking sector emerged as the top recruiting sector in 2024 across both the programs with offer distribution percentage of 29.9%.

hostel.description: Indian Institute of Management, Sirmaur provides twin sharing rooms with modern amenities. The hostel building is very close to the academic block, the rooms are properly ventilated and well lit. Each student is provided with a separate bed, mattress, almirah, and a bookrack. Every room has a separate washroom equipped with modern facilities. Housekeeping service maintains cleanliness in the rooms and an active staff takes care of mundane issues if at all they arise. High-speed Wi-Fi has been installed which is accessible from anywhere within the campus.
