reviews.review_heading: One of the most Ethical B-Schools in the country .
reviews.review_text: Although the old campus had each and every facility required to provide quality education, the upcoming new permanent campus will be the biggest IIM of the country area wise and will have world class facilities from one of the biggest libraries in the country to top notch industry software like the Bloomberg terminals. The quality of food was subpar while the sports environment was pretty good and you get to participate in multiple sports events every month.

reviews.review_heading: A new course which is well ahead of its time with great faculty, good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good. There is constant connectivity through Wi-Fi at all parts of the campus. The library is well-equipped with all your academic needs and the classrooms are spacious. The hostel rooms are spacious with the choice of single or double rooms. Moreover, the scenery is beautiful. The food is good (compared to average hostel standards). There are all kinds of sports facilities available ranging from football, cricket, badminton to billiards, carrom, chess etc.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Sirmaur: A perfect blend of knowledge and leadership to make better future.
reviews.review_text: IIM Sirmaur has Wi-Fi enabled campus with 24x7 access to the library for study, group discussion, and other academic-related activities to be carried out by students. The library is well-equipped with proper spacing, lighting, books, electronic devices, and other resources for the students. The institute provides access to online databases such as ABI/INFORMS, Library, EBSCO, ACE Equity, and Press Reader. Also, there is a well-equipped computer lab with the latest software running on cutting-edg...

reviews.review_heading: In short all about Himalayan IIM.
reviews.review_text: Hostel of IIM Sirmaur is well equipped with modern technology. One will find unlimited use of Wi-Fi which runs 24X7. Classrooms are well maintained as per the standard of an IIM with individual seating arrangement, currently a classroom can carry 72 student in one batch so that prof can pay attention to each student's properly. Computer lab is one of the best thing of IIM Sirmaur, students can access any system any time, which are also open for 24x7. Library is also accessible for 24x7, where st...

reviews.review_heading: The Himalayan IIM- A perfect blend of campus and placements.
reviews.review_text: The only baby IIM having separate campus and 210 Acre state of the art campus is under construction. Wi-Fi enabled campus and hostel, well-equipped gymnasium, a big grassy playground, advance classrooms, library, mess and what not. The hostel rooms are well furnished, quality of the food is commendable.

reviews.review_heading: A college in its budding state still miles to go.
reviews.review_text: Good Wi-Fi access and labs. Hostels are double Occupancy for both year students. Mess and quality of food being served is very poor. This was a constant problem throughout the year with only little improvements. Sports and games are very nicely equipped with a high class gym facility also.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Sirmaur is the best among the new IIMs.
reviews.review_text: It is a temporary campus, and the permanent campus is yet to come. Hostels are good with all amenities, and 2 persons can share a room. There is a common room with fridge, television and good Wi-Fi connectivity. A doctor is visiting the campus once a week. The mess provides typical north dishes which is average, but sports facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Sirmaur - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is near the Himalayas, and it's so beautiful to be in such a location. The entire campus Wi-Fi enabled, classrooms are with air-conditioners. The library on the campus is open 24x7. We also have a computer lab, and gym. Apart from these, we have indoor game facilities for TT, carrom, chess, snooker, etc. Outdoor games like football, cricket, volleyball, and badminton are also played.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Sirmaur- The Himalayan IIM.
reviews.review_text: The College has 24 by 7 Wi-Fi available. The classrooms, Labs, and Libraries are Fully air-conditioned. There are Mess and canteen services available. The college is equipped with flood lights, own football ground and various indoor games such as snooker, table tennis etc.

reviews.review_heading: IIM SIRMAUR - The Himalayan IIM.
reviews.review_text: We have a beautiful campus surrounded by mountains which justifies out name- The Himalayan IIM. We can access the library, gym, classrooms, auditorium, snooker and TT room 24x7. Every classroom is a modern classroom equipped with the latest projectors, sound systems and an efficient seating plan. Every classroom is equipped with Air Conditioners. Our campus has 100% Wi-Fi coverage. There an in house doctor on weekdays and an on-call doctor always available on weekends. Sports are whole heatedly ...

reviews.review_heading: IIM Sirmaur is worth joining.
reviews.review_text: IIM Sirmaur has not yet relocated to its permanent campus. The temporary campus has a main building with four floors where the bottom floor is the academic floor, and other floors have gym, hostels and library and the top floor is for faculty members. All the modern facilities are available in the campus.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best baby IIM to go for !
reviews.review_text: As it's a baby IIM, currently it don't have a permanent campus. Anyhow the permanent campus is under construction and it will be available in near future. Despite being the temporary campus, campus is one of the best campus as compared to other baby iims. All the facilities like gym, Library, laundry, mess, canteen, etc. Everything is available inside the campus. The campus also have Bloomberg terminal which is not available currently in any other baby iims. Rest assured, infrastructure of IIM S...

reviews.review_heading: Indian Institute of Management Sirmaur.
reviews.review_text: Currently we don't have a permanent campus. But the facilities provided in the temporary campus are excellent. We have a main building with bottom two floors having classrooms and other floors have hostels, gym, and library. There are seperate hostels for seniors and juniors and hostels have all the amenities.

reviews.review_heading: I am fascinated by good infrastructure and teaching methodologies.
reviews.review_text: Being IIM, Sirmaur doesn't have its permanent campus yet. However, at the temporary campus, all the infrastructural facilities are more than sufficient. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled having connectivity all over the places. It has well-organised classrooms, precious library, reading room, well-equipped gym, sports room, student hostels with all the facilities, etc. The mess provides a good quality of food with a variety of items.

reviews.review_heading: Baby IIM worth joining with good in-house and visiting faculty members. Student driven campus.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure here although is temporary but all the facilities are provided here. Classrooms are equipped with all the basic and modern facilities. Sports faculty members are pretty good here and we have facilities for all major sports here including snooker and table tennis.

faqs.question: Can I get into Graphic Era Deemed to be University without CAT?

faqs.answer: A:    Yes, Management Aptitude Test (MAT) is required for Graphic Era. Candidates must score well in entrance tests like CAT, MAT, and XAT. Students who have cleared the qualifying test must participate in group discussions and interview sessions. Admission to the Master of Business Administration is completely entrance-based. Candidates who have an undergraduate degree in any stream with a 60 percent aggregate (55 percent aggregate for reserved categories) are eligible to apply for a Master of Business Administration course at Graphic Era University.

reviews.review_heading: The college has amazing management. There are placement issues for BCA.
reviews.review_text: Graphic Era Deemed to be University has great facilities of labs and the library. Computers in the lab are in very good condition. There are many labs for practice and a huge library in different blocks. Classrooms are amazing. It provides a smart board in each class. The hostel is a little costly but gives amazing infrastructure and services. The food is pretty good. It has space for both indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with the university. It has a great environment and a great hospital.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is great. I love the information about the graphics its great infrastructure, health care, and living. The food is provided. It has many canteens which provide great taste. It has all the departments. There is a big ground, and it provides a lot of fun.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's a good college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is average as it only covers 35 acres. But it's quite large. It seems small as the college has a very large number of students, especially in B.Tech courses. The crowd is quite large. Playground is also below average as it's not that big.

reviews.review_heading: No doubt my college is much better than any other in terms of areas.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities that students got from the Graphic Era Deemed to be University are much better and match our expectations, as we expected them to be the same. The mess serves quite good quality of food.

reviews.review_heading: This college is for those students who are more active in events and fests.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent. The librarian and the library are also very large. Wi-Fi facilities are also available in the library. Classrooms could be more furnished, but they are good. The mess and canteen are also decent. There are medical facilities. Hostels are a little bit expensive.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty, infrastructure, etc, but not satisfied with placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Classes are amazing, and every class has a smart board installed in it. There are many labs inside the campus, which provide better exposure to the practical aspects of the course. There are also many libraries available. The hostel is good, the food is also good and hygienic, and the hostels are disciplined and have high security.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely a good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: If I tell you about facilities, it’s average in my department. I’m not telling about other departments. Quality of hostel I don’t know. Quality of food is good. There are 4-5 canteens where food is available. All things were available and good, like sports, games, and medical facilities too.

reviews.review_heading: Graphic Era University review.
reviews.review_text: Every required facility is available, good food and infrastructure of hostels. We enjoy the services provided in our hostel, and along with that, we have great transportation facilities supported by the hostel and the college. It is a great place to get exposure.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive review of my B.Tech ECE program.
reviews.review_text: GU central library reportedly holds over 1,74,700 technical books, many periodicals, and journals. It also has a digital library with more than 1,200 general reading rooms with 300-seat capacity, a book bank, and reference or leading facilities. The campus is described as fully Wi-Fi enabled, as wired and wireless internet access is reported to be available 24x7.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent, really good college.
reviews.review_text: Excellent, Graphic Era infrastructure, of course. The hostel was so excellent, and our course and department were so good. Labs, classrooms, library, canteen, medical facilities, sports and games, etc., are all very excellent. Also, the mess of every hostel is so good, and the college provides us with Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: Average college life at Graphic Era Deemed to be University. The crowd is lazy and distracted.
reviews.review_text: Most classrooms are outdated, like they were built 10-20 years ago. Wi-Fi is poor. First-year labs are bad. The library is cramped up in the break, and it's difficult to study as there are no power ports available. The quality of hostels is average, and so is the food. Medical facilities are average. Sports events and games are good.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive and industry-oriented B.Tech aerospace at GEU.
reviews.review_text: Over 90% of students got placed. The average package is 5.38 LPA, the median package is 7.25 LPA, and the highest is 54.80 LPA. Top recruiting companies are ISRO, Indian Air Force, Tata Advanced Systems, Airbus, DRDO, MRO, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied but could do better.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, and library are very good with comfortable seats and good equipment. Wi-Fi is average. For sports, the teams are good. Mess food is average, and canteens are great. Clinic is good for quick check-ups. Hostel facilities are good as they provide necessary things.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. The quality of hostel is good for the students, and the quality of food is also good. They provide different menu everyday for the students. The facilities for sports and medical in my thinking this college is the best.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements, infrastructure, but average faculty.
reviews.review_text: I don't live in the hostel but the infrastructure is good. I have heard from friends the hostels are decent with all time Wi-Fi and water coolers running 24 hours. The classrooms are more than good. The hostel is good, the mess food is decent, the canteen has variety, plus we have medical help, and sports and games facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) + Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Wonderful life at IMNU.

content.Placements: IMNU provides a 100% placement for its students. The highest package offered is 70 LPA, including international offers. The average package is 11.22 LPA and the median package is 10.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Morgan Stanley, Hero, BNY Mellon, Bank of America, Capgemini, Adani Wilmar, and many more. 100% of students got offered internships from our college in companies like Amul, Sodexo, Smytten, Arihant Capital, IMS, Times of India, and many other companies.
content.Infrastructure: High-speed Wi-Fi is available around the campus. The classrooms are very huge with great facilities like projectors, speakers, etc. Vending machines are also available near our BBA classrooms for us. We have a library named NIMA, which is very huge and spacious, with a lot of books and studying area. Hostel facilities are only there for female students in BBA. The hostel is very nice and clean. There are various hostels, H1, H2, H3, etc. NU follows a strictly vegetarian food policy. The quality of food is good.

individual_reviews.title: The college has good infrastructure and faculty members.

Mostly the companies come for sales roles and many banks go for the BFSI sector. Internships are provided in different sectors for different domains.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure for the MBA course are good enough. Wi-Fi is provided within the institute and also neat and clean. Classrooms and library are great, one big 5-floor library for all the departments and grounds for sports.

hostel_campus.college_name: Institute of Management Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: The Institute has separate hostel facilities for boys and girls. Both hostels are located on the campus. The hostel rooms are spacious and well- furnished. The hostels have sports and other recreational facilities such as cable TV and common room for interaction. All hostel rooms have Internet connectivity round the clock. The hostel mess is outsourced to a professional caterer.

library.description: The library provides access to a wide range of management and business information sources that include leading national and international business periodicals, in addition to an impressive collection of business databases, digitized corporate annual reports and CDs/ DVDs. The library has about 34000 books (including 617 E-books from Springer). The library subscribes to 14 databases and around 16,119 e-journals through databases such as EBSCOs, Business Source Complete, Academic Search Complete, JSTOR, Elsevier’s Science Direct: Business Management & Accounting Package, Emerald Management Extra and Oxford e-bundle. The library subscribes to ISI Emerging Markets Database which provides trade-related information from all over the world. The financial and economic databases subscribed to by the library are CMIE's Prowess IQ and Industry Outlook. The library also subscribes to Indiastat.com which is a socioeconomic database. The library is fully automated and accessible on the campus LAN and operates on open source software, KOHA. The user-friendly package facilitates issue and return of books online access to the catalogue, i.e. Web catalogue and reservation of books. The library has adopted the latest ICT tools like CD, DVD, multimedia kids, barcode scanners and text & graphics scanners for effective use of library services.

college_info.intro:
Tribhuvan Sahkari University is known for its MBA in Rural Management course. It is approved by AICTE and offers core courses such as Rural Finance, Microfinance, Rural Society & Polity, Marketing Management and Brand Management. The course helps students to assume challenging responsibilities in rural cooperatives and development organisations. The curriculum includes both theory and practical learning.
The university has a special segment called Village Field Segment (VFS) for the practical learning of the students. VFS provides students with a chance to understand the rural realities first-hand. The VFS segment also offers guidance on navigating rural society, markets, politics, institutional connections, and livelihoods from a team of mentors.

faqs.answer: SRM Medical College does not accept direct admissions to any of its programmes. Students must either qualify for the entrance (if applicable) or clear the eligibility to get selected. SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre accept students on an entrance basis for some of its programmes, such as MBBS and MD/MD. To get into those courses, students must appear and clear the NEET exam and participate in the counselling conducted by MCI. However, Health Science course admissions are subject to fulfilment of the eligibility criteria. Students are selected based on their overall academic performance and the availability of seats. Students can contact the admission help desk of the institute to know further.
faqs.question: Q: Can I get direct admission in SRM Medical College?

faqs.answer: The students are selected for MBBS admission in SRM Medical College based on their NEET score and NEET counselling. A NEET-qualified candidate is eligible to register for AIQ counselling and its subsequent rounds, at the official website of MCC. A merit list is then released on the same website and the candidates who have cleared the required cut-off for SRM Medical College MBBS are selected for admission.
faqs.question: Q: What are the selection criteria for SRM Medical College MBBS admission?

faqs.answer: SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre generally accepts NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) scores for admission to its medical programs. NEET is the common entrance examination conducted at the national level for admission to undergraduate medical courses (MBBS) and dental courses (BDS) in India.
faqs.question: Q: What entrance exam scores are accepted by SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre for admission?

faqs.answer: SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre is one of the leading medical institutions in India. The following is the admissions procedure for the many courses the college offers: For MBBS, candidates must apply for NEET UG conducted by NTA. Admission will be based on the qualifying marks obtained in NEET UG. For MD/MS programmes, admission will be based on the qualifying marks obtained in NEET PG. For DM and MCh programmes, admission will be based on NEET SS conducted by NBE.

overview_faqs.question: How costly is studying at SRM Medical College?
overview_faqs.answer: SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre is quite costly with the the highest fee being INR 1.4 crore. The college provides a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, and doctoral level courses. SRM MCHRC fees range between INR 30,000 and INR 1.4 crore. The most costly courses are MBBS, MD/MS, and MCh. Check out the table below to know about the total tuition fees of popular SRM Medical College courses:Course NameTotal Tuition Fees (Investment)BScINR 1.5 Lacs – INR 6 lakhMScINR 1.8 Lacs – INR 7.5 lakhMChINR 24 Lacs – INR 45 lakhMBBSINR 1.1 croreMDINR 1.4 croreMSINR 1.4 croreNote: This information is taken from official sources and is subject to change.

overview_faqs.question: Is MBBS available in SRM Medical College?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, SRM Medical College offers MBBS course at the UG level. This course is offered for a duration of four and half years with one year of compulsory rotating internship. The total seat intake for this course is 250. The seats for MBBS course is filled via scores obtained in the NEET UG entrance exam. Candidates seeking for admission to this course are required to pass Class 12 with Science stream and qualify for NEET UG exam with a valid score. The curriculum of this course covers subjects such as Anatomy, Sugery, Medicine, Forensic Medicine, Physiology, etc.

overview_faqs.question: What is the course fee of MBBS programme at SRM Medical College?
overview_faqs.answer: As per the course fee details mentioned on the official website of SRM Medical College for the MBBS course, the annual fee for the course is INR 25 lakh. Candidates also have to pay a registration amount of INR 10,000 in the first year only. Futher, the accommodation charges are separate for boys and girls. Students who get selected via the NEET UG counselling process have to pay a certain amount of fee at the time of physical reporting to lock their seat.

individual_reviews.title: Overall 4 years in SRM was very good. I passed out with a good CGPA.

content.Placements: I got selected in 2 placement interviews conducted in the college. So placement interviews do happen. Around 7 students from my class got placed though many did not get placed but if you have the skill set, the chances of getting placed are very high. paragraphs: SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre admissionis a decided on bothmeritandentrance. The college offers distinct courses at different level in the field of Medical Science.SRM Medical Collegeoffers courses in affiliation with theSRM ISTwhich is ratified by the Medical Council of India (MCI). Read the more details to learn all about the courses, eligibility, fees, scholarship, and admission process of SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre.

At SRM Medical College, students can do various undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral, and diploma levels courses. The college gives seats for both Indian and international students. Find the elaborative details in the following columns:

The total tuition fee of SRM Medical College includes several components, some of which need to be paid only once at the time of admission, while the remaining components are charged yearly/ semester-wise.SRM HRMC feesrange betweenINR 30,000andINR 1.4 crore,making the medical courses of the college lean towards expensive when it comes to affordability. Additionally, students also need to pay a non-refundable registration fee of INR 10,000 for MBBS and MD/ MS programmes. Admission to all medical courses is done through valid scores of national-level entrance for the respective courses. Interested students can see the below-mentioned guide to complete theSRM Medical College admission process:

Aspirants seeking admission to the medical programmes offered by SRM Medical College course admission must apply on the official website of the respective entrance exam. Once the results are out, students can apply for SRM Medical College through the MCI counselling. For the remaining programmes, the application can be completed through the institute’s official website.

Admission to MBBS, MD/MS and DM/ MCh is based on scores of NEET UG, NEET PG and NEET SS, respectively. Later on, the shortlisted candidates will be allocated seats through a counselling process. For Health Science courses, seats are offered based on the academic merit of the student.

All the NEET qualifiers have to register for the counselling process conducted by the MCC of DGHS on the official website of the conducting body and pay the registration fee and a refundable security deposit. During the choice filling for Round 1, candidates have to select SRM Medical College and choose their desired course with specialisation. Further, round-wise merit lists will be released on the official website of MCC. Candidates who manage to secure a seat in Round 1 can proceed with the process, whereas the remaining candidates have to appear for other counselling rounds such as Round 2, Mop-up Round and Stray Vacancy Round.

Candidates who are allocated seats need to download their allotment letter and report at SRM Medical College in person for the document verification process and fee payment to lock their seats within the stipulated timeline.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in SRM Medical College?
faqs.answer: SRM Medical College does not accept direct admissions to any of its programmes. Students must either qualify for the entrance (if applicable) or clear the eligibility to get selected. SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre accept students on an entrance basis for some of its programmes, such as MBBS and MD/MD. To get into those courses, students must appear and clear the NEET exam and participate in the counselling conducted by MCI. However, Health Science course admissions are subject to fulfilment of the eligibility criteria. Students are selected based on their overall academic performance and the availability of seats. Students can contact the admission help desk of the institute to know further.

faqs.question: Are admissions open in SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre?
faqs.answer: Yes, admissions for the MBBS course in SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre are open. The application process for the MBBS course begins in October and closes in December. The selection process for the MBBS course is based on the NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) score.The NEET is a national-level entrance exam for medical and dental colleges in India. The exam is held once a year in May. To be eligible for the NEET, candidates must have passed the 12th standard with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English as compulsory subjects.

faqs.question: What are the selection criteria for SRM Medical College MBBS admission?
faqs.answer: The students are selected forMBBSadmission in SRM Medical College based on their NEET score and NEET counselling. A NEET-qualified candidate is eligible to register for AIQ counselling and its subsequent rounds, at the official website of MCC. A merit list is then released on the same website and the candidates who have cleared the required cut-off for SRM Medical College MBBS are selected for admission.

NIT Trichy popular programmes are BTech and MTech. BTech is given in nine specialisations for a four-year duration spread over eight semesters. NIT Trichy BTech in Computer Science and Engineering students can look for career opportunities and can become Computer Engineers, Testing Engineers, Multimedia programmers, Full Stack Developers, and others. After doing a BTech in Civil Engineering, students will gain the ability to implement infrastructure development by using various sustainable technologies and materials.
NIT Trichy's MTech programme is a two-year postgraduate programme given in 23 specialisations. Some of the specialisations in which MTech is taught are Geotechnical Engineering, Thermal Power Engineering, VLSI Systems, and others. NIT Trichy is ranked 9th under the Engineering category. review_summary.college_name: NIT Trichy Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure, but a bad climate in the summer. There are exceptional peers.

content.Placements: I'm not sure about the percentage of students who got internships or placements. I suggest that students just check it out on the college website. It is legitimate. But to be frank, the packages offered in core, as I know, in production are very few. But this branch is special in offering the connection between management and technical fields. Excellent packages and placements are available in non-core fields, especially consulting and management. The branch is a chill one, which offers ample time for studying anything or extracurricular activities.
content.Infrastructure: The library facility, octagon, or if I say anything in the college, is just on a different level, except for hostels. Being a college affiliated with NIRF 9, we expect much better from their side in hostel management. There is no responsibility on their part if a theft happens. Actually, two laptops were stolen. The library must have a proper internet connection, which is bad. The hostel is improving right now with proper renovation after our complaints. It serves very good mess food. I'll say much better than any college. Since I've been in some.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has one of the best placement records. Classes are a bit hectic, but overall, it's good.

content.Placements: There is an 80 percent placement rate in B.Tech civil engineering. The lowest package offered is 3 LPA, and the highest package offered is 33 LPA. For tech fields, companies like Microsoft and Google, and for core companies like Dalmia, ACC Cement, L&T, etc., hire students. Internships are not very common in this branch, so we have to fight a bit more compared to other branches.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel and mess facilities are among the best across all NITs and IITs. We have high-speed Wi-Fi in each room. The mess food is great compared to other top colleges. There is a curfew for first-year boys. For girls, it is for all four years. We have an NIT Hospital for medical issues or emergencies. NIT Trichy has one of the top sports infrastructures.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Amazing college with decent facilities. But the climate is very hot and there is language barrier.

content.Placements: The percentage of placements in our course is really nice, it is more than (94)%. Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, Micron, Synapse, Google, Amazon, Oracle, TCS, Wipro, Bajaj, etc. (These are mixed companies for electronics, software, and electrical). Chip designer, electro manager, developed (to be honest, I don't know much about the role they offer). The highest and lowest salary is average.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are not up to the mark. There are equipments in our lab, but very less in number, and that too sometimes does not work properly. We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. We have good computer lab and library, but we don't have Wi-Fi in library. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quality is good). But North-Indians may not like the taste initially.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I felt absolutely good about joining this college because of its good infrastructure and placements.

content.Placements: Now I am a fresher here. If we look at the placements at NIT Trichy, they are amazing. To be honest, I am from the Civil Engineering branch, so we cannot expect high packages, but our seniors get into many PSUs. The alumni here help the most with placements. Last year, nearly 78% of students were placed in my course. The highest package is 34 LPA and 20 LPA for core jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities on campus are good. We can find everything in the campus supermarket (2k). If we talk about the hostels, as you know, NIT Trichy is an old college, so it has very old hostels, but the good thing is that they have been renovated this year. Wi-Fi is very good. For the first few years, they accommodated us in the Kailesh mess. The food here is not very good, but in the second year, we can choose any mess we want, and those are very good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The institute offers strong academics and campus life, with scope for better industry exposure.

content.Placements: CSE / IT placements are around 95–100%, while the overall placement percentage at NIT Trichy is above 90%. The highest package offered is 45–55 LPA from international and top product companies, the average package is 25–30 LPA, and the lowest package is 6–8 LPA. Top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, and the major roles offered are Software Development Engineer (SDE), Backend / Full-Stack Developer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, and AI Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The campus provides 24×7 high-speed Wi-Fi across academic blocks and hostels. Laboratories consist of computer labs with high-performance systems. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated. They are equipped with smart boards, projectors, and audio systems.

reviews.review_heading: It has one of the best placement records. Classes are a bit hectic, but overall, it's good.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and mess facilities are among the best across all NITs and IITs. We have high-speed Wi-Fi in each room. The mess food is great compared to other top colleges. There is a curfew for first-year boys. For girls, it is for all four years. We have an NIT Hospital for medical issues or emergencies. NIT Trichy has one of the top sports infrastructures.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college with decent facilities. But the climate is very hot and there is language barrier.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are not up to the mark. There are equipments in our lab, but very less in number, and that too sometimes does not work properly. We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. We have good computer lab and library, but we don't have Wi-Fi in library. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quali...

reviews.review_heading: I felt absolutely good about joining this college because of its good infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities on campus are good. We can find everything in the campus supermarket (2k). If we talk about the hostels, as you know, NIT Trichy is an old college, so it has very old hostels, but the good thing is that they have been renovated this year. Wi-Fi is very good. For the first few years, they accommodated us in the Kailesh mess. The food here is not very good, but in the second year, we can choose any mess we want, and those are very good.

reviews.review_heading: The institute offers strong academics and campus life, with scope for better industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: The campus provides 24×7 high-speed Wi-Fi across academic blocks and hostels. Laboratories consist of computer labs with high-performance systems. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated. They are equipped with smart boards, projectors, and audio systems.

reviews.review_heading: It is a fine college if you take higher branches like ECE, CS, EEE, mechanical, and chemical.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are above average. Wi-Fi is installed in every room, now no problem with Wi-Fi. Quality of the hostel is good. Mess food is also good. Here they emphasize sports and extracurricular activities also. They also organise events, guest lectures, and workshops.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life and experience in NIT Trichy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Classes for all department students occur in academic blocks like Orion and Logos, but we suffer in summer due to the high temperature of Trichy. The hostel facilities are also quite good. Every room has Wi-Fi. This year, they also introduced washing machines, which are on a pay-and-use system. I give 3/5 for the food because the taste does not seem good, and the varieties are also repeated. You can find many canteens, and you can also find Domino’s and CCD. The ...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure but disappointing in some aspects.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nice. Hostels are not that much good as their NIRF is 9 but not too bad, it's okay to have such a hostel. College infrastructure is very nice. Library is also good. Food is not good in the first year but for North and South people they have different messes in college.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the course.
reviews.review_text: Almost everything is right in its place. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel rooms with routers in each room. Labs are there in every department, and classrooms will be happening in Orion. The library is present with well-structured and department-wise sections. Every day, the hostel is cleaned by workers and is maintained very hygienically. For food, we have Annapurna mess, Mega mess, and Sabari mess. The quality of food varies from mess to mess, and overall quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college for this course.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided in the room include a table, chair, almirah and a bed. The mess food is okay, not so good, but one will get used to it. If we talk about the books and journals available in the library, they are easily accessible to all the students and professors. The classrooms have high-quality projectors and speakers, and teachers use a microphone to deliver their lectures. There are a lot of sports available on campus, and everyone can play any sport they want to play.

reviews.review_heading: If you want, then you can join, but you have to score well on the GATE entrance.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are decent, I think. In the first year, there are 3 people in a single room, while the room can hold three people, the cupboards provided are for only two people. Wi-Fi all over the campus with cctv security. Labs are good. The library is good, it has all types of books. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. There are many grounds for different sports. There is also a swimming pool.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, good location, good IIT.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good, like every other college. Cleanliness is a factor that the hostels possess. Sports and extracurricular activities are good in college. But unlike many IITs, they won't offer coaches to the respective college teams. There is Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and all types of books are available.

reviews.review_heading: National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is provided and very useful for networking. In labs, AC and projectors are provided. Classrooms are good, and AC and projectors are provided for display. The library is good and provides AC and projectors. Hostel is good, with quality food.

reviews.review_heading: I like my institute so much for the best environment.
reviews.review_text: The buildings of my institute, that is NIT Trichy, are so good and well structured, and the most important thing is that the greenery here is so good. The hostel is well-furnished and also provides Wi-Fi facilities, and the mess food is not that bad to eat.

reviews.review_heading: Good environment and peaceful campus.

It's a good environment to stay in, and it's full of facilities available. 
The library is filled with all types of journals, and e-books are also available in the library. 
Classrooms are neat, and good seating facilities are available on the campus. 
There are all types of sports and training available.

review_summary.college_name: Christ University Bangalore Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc (Hons) in Psychology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Christ University is a good college with good academic and extracurricular exposure.

content.Placements: Mandatory internships and service learning courses are incorporated in the course to enable networking. Since internships have to be pursued from the 1st year, students have a higher probability of getting placed. The institution also encourages students to do courses and participate in extracurricular activities.
content.Infrastructure: Canteen has a variety of options such as Domino’s, Express Coffee, etc. There are other outlets, such as Subway and Leon’s, in the college vicinity. Infrastructure is ample and well-maintained. It includes private study rooms, a 2000-seater auditorium, an amphitheatre, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) (Hons) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and relevant courses.

content.Placements: The placement percentage ratio at Christ University Yeshwanthpur campus is quite satisfactory, and varies according to different programs and specialisations but to give it a number, around 70-90% of students get placed. The highest package goes up to 33 LPA, and often ranges between 15 LPA - 30 LPA. While an internship is an integral part of the university, all students have to actively take up internships. Top recruiters for Yeshwanthpur campus are Deloitte, DE Shaw and Co, Infosys, etc.
content.Infrastructure: This campus is one of the youngest campuses amongst all Christ campuses, a lot of care and thought has been put into the infrastructure. It has been well-paced with modern technologies. There is proper space for sports, a well-equipped, and established auditorium.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued (Sep 2024)- B.Com (Hons) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Not worth the hustle for a degree.

content.Placements: Around 87% of the students get the placements. There are students who secure more CGPA scores therefore companies that offer great LPA packages. Very few students with good portfolios get through the interviews with good packages and hard work matters.
content.Infrastructure: There are Wi-Fi jammers, classrooms are clean, and library is pretty much spacious. The food can be disgusting as it has no taste, sports but medical facilities are very generous. Hostels and washrooms are clean. It has been 4 years since it's built.

individual_reviews.course: MBA (Business Analytics) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: This is the best university for MBA course.

content.Placements: MBA courses are well represented in recruitment here. Every year, approximately 30–35 companies visit the college to recruit students. Top hiring firms include Mahindra & Mahindra, IndusInd Bank, and Bank of Baroda. The package offered is 23 LPA–36 LPA. Our batch placement was excellent with several students employed in reputable companies. Top positions available include investment banker, HR manager, and others.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is clean, and the atmosphere at the university is always positive. The buildings are well-maintained and there are gardens and parks where people can socialize. The university cafeteria serves delicious meals. The campus is situated on the outskirts of the city making it pollution-free and healthy.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Commerce (M.Com.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall best University for M. Com. course.

content.Placements: Almost all of the students were placed in reputable companies. The highest salary offered is 25 LPA, while the lowest is 5 LPA. Top recruiters include Byju’s, Jaro Education, and Planet Spark. The training and placement officer is quite helpful, and securing internships and jobs is simple. Higher-level roles include tax advisory, financial analyst, and others.
content.Infrastructure: Our university infrastructure is extremely good. There are restaurants on both ends of the campus. The university offers a bus service that stops at the campus. The campus also contains a library, a gym, a parking lot, and Wi-Fi is available on both ends of the campus and throughout the surrounding areas.

Companies like ICICI Bank, Kia Motors, BMW, Tech Mahindra, Mahindra Finance, and Godrej Properties visit consistently. The average package for the recent batch has been around 16–17 LPA, while the highest for this batch till now is 30 LPA, with placements still going on. The placement team is supportive, and most students get roles aligned with their interests.
content.Infrastructure: The college doesn’t have an in-campus hostel but has a third-party hostel just 1.5 kms away from the college campus. The hostel life is full of connection and networking opportunities. The college campus is surrounded with greenery, which makes the environment ideal for study.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Placements were through umbrella placements, with 150+ companies coming to the campus.

content.Placements: The best part was the umbrella placement at FORE. Competition was there, but I was able to secure a decent summer internship of Rs 35,000 per month and a final placement of 15 LPA CTC. 150+ companies visited the campus. The highest package was offered by a company based in Dubai of 70 LPA. There were 100% placements provided you had never failed in any course. Otherwise, you were not eligible for placements. I happily pursued my job after college was over.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel was top-notch. Your Space was literally the best choice for accommodation in South Delhi. The room had a desk and chair for study, a balcony, big windows for ample lighting, a proper basin area, a huge cupboard space for groceries, and a huge almirah for clothing. Bathrooms had geyser facilities, rooms had proper lighting, and dustbins were available in every room. Rooms were available on a double and triple sharing basis. Meals were moderately good. The fee structure for double sharing was Rs. 1,89,900, and for triple sharing was Rs. 1,65,500.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in International Business - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure, faculty, and peer group are awesome.

content.Placements: Placement is really good here, all the top companies came on campus for hiring, for example, BMW, ITC, Asian Paints, Brain, and ICICI Bank. The highest package offered by Arcesium is 28 LPA, and the average package is 12 LPA. The college is known for Marketing, but students get huge opportunities in finance, HR, and BDA as well.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is top-notch. Your Space is literally the best choice for accommodation in South Delhi. The room has desk and chair for study, a balcony, big windows for ample lighting, a proper basin area, a huge cupboard space for groceries, and a huge almirah for clothing. Bathrooms have geyser facilities, rooms have proper lighting, and dustbins are available in every room.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Big Data Analytics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the college as the faculty members are very supportive.

content.Placements: This college has decent placement opportunities. More than 90% of the batch got placed. Some of the top recruiters include Brain and Company, Mercedes-Benz, Accenture, Deloitte, Gartner, EY, PWC and many more. In this college, there are two specialisations offered as majors. It has an umbrella placement process. If you are eligible for the company, you can sit for the company.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides all the necessary facilities for our course. We have Wi-Fi across the campus and computer labs with advanced systems. The library is well-stocked with different resources. Classes are modern and equipped with projectors and other basic amenities. There is a medical room available on the campus. We also have a designed area for games, while the sports area is not very large, but good enough for regular use.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in International Business - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The fact is that even though the infrastructure is small, we still have all the amenities available.

content.Placements: This college provides campus placement, and many students get good packages. Still, the college is working on giving the students a bright future. More than 70% of students get placement through college according to me. College provides so many internships, that help us to grow and have practical knowledge. I can proudly say that my college gives the chance to almost every student to apply for internships, but due to some reasons, some of the students appear and some did not.
content.Infrastructure: The campus life at FORE is fun, with students visibly running in the corridors to reach classes on time or checking out the terrace for the best view possible. The college provides an amalgamation of culture and social spirit in all the events it organizes.

admission_process.title: FORE School of Management Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: FORE School of Management admissionsare primarily entrance-based. The school accepts national-level entrance exams such as CAT, XAT, etc. for admission to PGDM.FORE School of Managementoffers PGDM and FPM courses across various specialisations in the Management stream. Candidates can apply for the course of their choice online on the school's official website.

The School of Management offers courses in full-time mode across various specialisations. Candidates can check out the table below for some key highlights about theFORE School of Management admission:
FORE School of Management Admission Brochure

Candidates need to pass a minimum graduation for PGDM and a master's degree for FPM courses. Admission is based on the entrance exam score for both programmes. Check below the eligibility and selection criteria forFORE School of Management courses:
Graduation in any discipline or equivalent with at least 50% aggregate (final year appearing students can also apply)
XAT/CAT/GMAT+ Extempore + PI + Work Experience (Fresher's can also apply)
Master’s degree or its equivalent inEngineeringand Technology/ Management/Economics/ Social Science/ Biological Science/ Pure Science/ Commerce/ Humanities with first-class score

FORE School of Management admission processincludes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list or counselling and other steps. Eligible candidates must start by filling out the application form for admission. Check below the step-wiseFSM admission process:

Candidates have to submit the application fee & required documents to apply for FORE School of Management admission. For FPM, candidates must pay an application fee of INR 2,500 (including taxes). Aspirants have to pay an application fee of INR 1,770 for one PGDM programme.

Candidates will be shortlisted for PGDM based on their scores in the CAT/ XAT/ GMAT exam. Selected candidates are further called for an extempore and personal interview round. The school will also consider the work experience and academic performance of the students to provide admission. For FPM, the school selects candidates based on GATE/ GRE/ GMAT/ UGC-NET or JFR/ CSIR score followed by a personal interview round and presentation.

The school selects candidates based on their entrance exam score, performance in the extempore, personal interview round, academic performance of the aspirants and their work experience for the PGDM programme. Once selected, aspirants receive an admission letter. Shortlisted candidates must pay theFSM feeto confirm their seat in the institute.

reviews.review_heading: FORE – A decision towards self growth.
reviews.review_text: The college doesn’t have an in-campus hostel but has a third-party hostel just 1.5 kms away from the college campus. The hostel life is full of connection and networking opportunities. The college campus is surrounded with greenery, which makes the environment ideal for study.

reviews.review_heading: Placements were through umbrella placements, with 150+ companies coming to the campus.
reviews.review_text: Hostel was top-notch. Your Space was literally the best choice for accommodation in South Delhi. The room had a desk and chair for study, a balcony, big windows for ample lighting, a proper basin area, a huge cupboard space for groceries, and a huge almirah for clothing. Bathrooms had geyser facilities, rooms had proper lighting, and dustbins were available in every room. Rooms were available on a double and triple sharing basis. Meals were moderately good. The fee structure for double sharing w...

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure, faculty, and peer group are awesome.

The room has desk and chair for study, a balcony, big windows for ample lighting, a proper basin area, a huge cupboard space for groceries, and a huge almirah for clothing. Bathrooms have geyser facilities, rooms have proper lighting, and dustbins are available in every room.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college as the faculty members are very supportive.

The library is well-stocked with different resources. Classes are modern and equipped with projectors and other basic amenities. There is a medical room available on the campus. We also have a designed area for games, while the sports area is not very large, but good enough for regular use.

reviews.review_heading: The fact is that even though the infrastructure is small, we still have all the amenities available.
reviews.review_text: The campus life at FORE is fun, with students visibly running in the corridors to reach classes on time or checking out the terrace for the best view possible. The college provides an amalgamation of culture and social spirit in all the events it organizes.

reviews.review_heading: The best college from my experience.

FORE School only coordinated with MS Rajhans Home to facilitate the availability of accommodation for its being in the near vicinity of the institute. Rooms offered by Rajhans Home to FORE School of Management were in two blocks, i.e., F-109 and F-113 air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: It is a decent college. I suggest students make their decisions wisely.

Sports and other related competitions are given optimum facilities. The infrastructure is great, and the college is fully air-conditioned for the apt temperature.

reviews.review_heading: Good MBA College in Delhi NCR.

review_summary.college_name: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc.(Hons) in Chemistry with Botany - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College placement is not so good, their percentage is very low.

content.Placements: The strength of my class is 79. Almost all students get an internship. Colleges offer students the opportunity to got internship from another college or industry. If they do not approach any industry or college, then the college itself provides the internship. The average package forwarded in my courses is Rs. 50000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: Lab in the first and 2nd semester is done once a week, and in the third semester it is twice a week, and in the 4th semester it is 4 days a week. There are two batches of Chemistry. The maximum number of students doing lab together is 30 or more.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: If you want a good package, then you should join this college.

content.Placements: Almost 95-96 percent of students in electrical have been placed. The highest package given is 1.2 crore per annum, which was in the field of cybersecurity. The lowest is around 12 LPA, and the average package is around 27 LPA, while the median is around 30 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Texas Instruments, Microsoft, and Nvidia. Around 50 percent of students from electrical engineering grab an internship. Specifically, this year, 55 students got an internship. [8 core and rest non-core ] Top roles include SDE, cybersecurity, VLSI designer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Sometimes there is a problem with Wi-Fi connectivity in our hostel rooms. The library is very good, and it contains all types of books that are required. Classrooms are okay. Labs are very good, but some of the equipment has mechanical errors. The medical facility is excellent. Food quality depends on which type of mess you have joined, like in a sattvik mess, where Jain food is served, the quality of food is excellent compared to other messes. The sports facility is also very good. The canteen also provides good food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with my college IIT BHU because of facilities and good placement in 2026.

content.Placements: In the electronics branch, the placement percentage is approximately 81 percent. The highest package is 90 LPA, the lowest is 7.5 LPA, and the average is 23.5 LPA. Top companies are Google, Microsoft, and Nvidia. 40 percent of students got internships in core jobs, where the major company was Nvidia, and a few also got internships in SDE. Roles include VLSI, embedded systems, and PCB.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are very good at IIT BHU. Wi-Fi covers the entire campus, and classrooms are fully modernized. There are 4 lecture theatres in our college. For freshers, IIT BHU has the best hostel among all IITs, named PC Ray Hostel, which covers all required infrastructure and is newly made, so it looks aesthetic as well. There are 3 huge grounds in IIT BHU, which cover facilities for all sports. We have SAC for indoor games and a newly made gym, which is the biggest sports auditorium as well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) Physics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our college is the best for serious students.

content.Placements: There were very few placement offers, because most of the students preferred higher studies in their respective fields. Actually, since there was no specific placement cell for UG students, there was a very low number of students who got placed, i.e., 30-40 percent of students were getting placed or less than that.
content.Infrastructure: There was a decent hostel in our college, which was not too good, but there were some basic facilities provided by the hostel, like free Wi-Fi, and there was also a place for playing outdoor games. Overall, it was 7/10, and the infrastructure of the course was good. You don't have much pressure, you have time to explore new things and find your interests.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Dairy Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Average for dairy, above average for college life.

content.Placements: The placement scenario of the college is moderate. On average, students receive salary packages ranging from 5 to 6 LPA. Lactalis, Amul and Vadilal visit the campus for recruitment. The placements at the college are average, but the table and its BHU, so in future it will develop for sure.
content.Infrastructure: The college has good and well-maintained infrastructure that supports both academic and extracurricular activities. Our college is big, but our department isn't; we need more strength as students and as teachers, too. Classrooms and laboratories are properly equipped. Only ICAR students can get a hostel (SRK HOSTEL).

paragraphs: BHU admissionsare primarily entrance-based. All Indian applicants are required to take the CUET-UG exam conducted by the NTA. Candidates must apply online on the NTA CUET official website to register themselves. For PG courses, aspirants with a valid CUET-PG score can apply. Admission to some courses can be merit-based. BHU considers CUET-UG scores and normalised scores to create merit lists for each course.
What is the BHU Application Process 2026?

For UG courses admission through CUET, candidates have to complete theCUET-UG application process. Likewise, forBHU PG admissions, theCUET-PG applicationprocess has to be completed. For other courses, the aspirants can apply through BHU official website.

BHU counselling process for PG courses through CUET-PG is carried out in online mode. Registrations for it get started before CUET results are out and open after that for scorecard upload. Find below the detailed procedure of BHU CUET-PG counselling:

Visit the university's official website(bhuonline.in)to participate in the online counselling process. To register, enter yourNTA application number, and other details along with your email ID and a passwordto activate the registration account.

Login with the Email ID and password entered during registration. After login, fill out the application and upload documents. Candidates must upload the documents inPDF/JPEG format. Moreover, the required documents are enlisted below:
Bachelor's mark sheet (make a single file of marks sheet of all semesters and then upload the same as a single document)
Certificate if admission under sports quota
Scanned copy of a recent colour photograph & signature

In order to register successfully, anon-refundablefee has to be paid via debit card/credit card/net banking. Candidates canedit the application before fee payment. Find below the registration fee for each of the categories:

The preference entry page opens after the registration fee payment. Candidates can fill in their preferences separately for all the programmes in this form. Moreover, the result for the first seat allotment is declared within 8 to 10 days (approximately) after the publication of theCUET-PG result. Further, subsequent rounds for regular/paid fee seats for the BHU and affiliated colleges are carried out.

faqs.question: Does BHU accept admission through CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, Banaras Hindu University accept CUET score for multiple UG courses, including BA (Hons), BCom (Hons) BSc (Hons), etc. The university is also offering admission to its PG courses based on merit in CUET-PG. Aspirants who meet the eligibility requirements can register on the BHU admission portal for counselling. The admission is done in order of merit based on the normalised score of the CUET (PG) and reservation policy as per the provisions laid down in the BHU PET Information Brochure.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for the BHU UET?
faqs.answer: BHU accepts CUET-UG scores for admission to several UG courses. Candidates seeking admission to BHU must apply online to register themselves. Follow the step-wise admission process as given below:The BHU application process is conducted in online mode through the official website of NTA (nta.ac.in). The fee for General category students is INR 750, INR 700 for OBC-NCL/EWS, and INR 650 for SC/ST/PwD/Transgender.Candidates need to download the admit card by visiting the official website of CUET 2025 and clicking on 'Download CUET Admit Card'.After the declaration of the CUET result, students seeking admission to BHU UG courses are required to apply online for CUET-UG Counselling on the BHU UG admission portal.Further, candidates are required to participate in an online counselling process for provisional admission to the course (s). After that, the final seat allotment will be done by BHU.

faqs.question: What is the last date for BHU admission?
faqs.answer: BHU accepts CUET scores for admission to UG and PG courses. The admissions are over within few weeks of CUET counselling. CUET-PG is usually jeld in March whereas, CUET-UG takes place in May. Students must check the complete schedule for exact dates. CUET applications for the coming year will begin in February and continue till April.

faqs.question: Can a one-year dropper student get admission into BHU?
faqs.answer: Banaras Hindu University course admissions is entrance-based for most of the programmes. Thus, one-year dropper student can apply for the desired course, however, qualifying the respective entrance is the a must. Apart from this, aspirant should meet the course-specific minimum eligibility requirements as well.Moreover, the student can be asked to submit an application regarding the reason for drop out. Sometimes even this is not required.

placement_data.title: Banaras Hindu University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The highest and average package recorded during BHU MBA & MBA IB placements 2025 were INR 19.8 LPA and INR 10.1 LPA , respectively. For MBA Agri-Business course, the highest and average package recorded this year were INR 16 LPA and INR 8.7 LPA . During Banaras Hindu University MBA and MBA IB placements 2025, most number of profiles offered was of Consultant whereas for MBA Agri-Business program, Management Trainee emerged as the top profile.

According to the NIRF report 2025 released the median package offered to UG 3 year was INR 8 LPA during the BHU placements 2024. Moreover, the median packages offered to UG 4 Year and UG 5 Year were INR 9 LPA and INR 16 LPA , respectively. Further, the median package received during BHU placement 2024 for PG 2-year and PG 3-year programs were INR 9 LPA and INR 13.5 LPA , respectively.

review_summary.college_name: BIMTECH Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in International Business - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied as the college doesn't meet the required expectations.

content.Placements: My batch strength is 72. 56 students got placed, which makes an approximate percentage of 76%. The highest package is 22 LPA. The lowest is 6 LPA. Infosys, Wipro, BlackRock, KPMG, and OXANE Partners come here. Internships are pretty bad, students had to get it from outside sources. There are some top recruiters for internships like Oxaane, KPMG, DIGIT, etc. Top roles are consultant, area sales manager, and financial adviser.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. There is Wi-Fi on campus and hostel premises. The quality of the food will satisfy everyone, not that of regular hostel food. The menu is good. Every day they serve good things.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in International Business - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Reality of Birla Institute of Management Technology.

content.Placements: There are companies like EY, Deloitte, Capgemini, KPMG, Marsh, Wipro, Go Digit, and many blooming companies like Equity Knowledge and Morphedo also came for placements in Marketing, Finance, and HR, but for operations, rarely any company comes. The average placement is 9-10 Lacs with a minimum of 6 Lacs and a maximum of 12-13 Lacs. In the batch of 2025, around 70% of students got placed. These companies hire at the roles of Business Development Analyst, Investment Banker, Management Trainee, and Executive too. For the internship in the batch of 2026, about 30% secured the internships.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good experience at BIMTECH.

content.Placements: Some of the companies that visit the campus for placements include Wipro, EY, BlackRock, ICICI Bank, Oxane, TVS, Darwin Box, Panasonic, and more. The college provides good opportunities for placements. Companies offer roles in finance, HR, marketing, consulting, operations, etc.
content.Infrastructure: BIMTECH provides good infrastructure. Classrooms have smart screens, which enhance the learning experience. The college provides seminar halls, IT/computer labs, an activity plaza, etc. Campus life at BIMTECH is also good. The campus provides amenities like a gym, basketball court, badminton court, cafeteria, tuck shop, and more.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in International Business - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: BIMTECH: the next best choice.

content.Placements: The placements each year increase, as the placement cell is really efficient here and provides 100% placement. Companies such as KPMG, Bain, Deloitte, and BlackRock come here. The average package is 1,300,000, and the highest package is 2,600,000, which, as a fresher, is good.
content.Infrastructure: Four types of courses are provided: General, IB, IBM, and RM. The hostel is really good, the food especially. The menu changes every month, and salad and sweets are complimentary. Hygiene is well-maintained here, and you get both AC and a theater. The quality is good.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Insurance Business Management - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Worth to take admission in BIMTECH.

content.Placements: The overall placements are 100%. The college is providing the best opportunities, and every person gets a good amount of chances to give interviews. The highest package is 24-25 lakhs, and the average package is 9-10 lakhs. All the MNCs like Accenture and Deloitte are coming to the campus.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure in the college is the best. We have a big library that helps us stay updated with books and the newly constructed Bloomberg lab, which helps us get data for our study purposes. Along with the mess and canteen, which are very good, the infrastructure is totally worth it.

paragraphs: The admission to BIMTECH is a multi-stage procedure that has a number of stages like application, shortlisting and payment of fees. The institute conducts admission in the online manner. Since the admisison process is entrance based, ensure to score a valid point in the entrance examination and other selection rounds. The students would be able to join the programmes provided in the institute by satisfying the basic eligibility and the selection criteria. Find below the steps of the BIMTECH admission process:

Go to the official BIMTECH website and apply to the required programme by filling the application form (https://online.admissions.bimtech.ac.in). The application fee is INR 2,250. The form should be duly completed and the application fee paid by the student so as to submit the application form successfully.

Shortlisting will be done based on valid scores obtained by the students in a national-level entrance test like CAT/ XAT/ CMAT/ MAT/ GMAT, etc. Along with high marks achieved in the entrance examinations, take part in the personal interview, as well as the extempore round, which will also be held by the institute. All certificates, mark sheets and degrees submitted by applicants for seeking admission to any program in BIMTECH will be sent for verification to the issuing authorities. placement_data.title: BIMTECH Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: BIMTECH has concluded the placements for its PGDM batch 2025. The highest and average package secured by the batch 2025 was INR 22 LPA and INR 10.74 LPA. The median package was INR 10 LPA. More than 160 recruiters took part in the BIMTECH placement drive 2025, of which 52 were new recruiters. They hire students in various fields such as Consultancy, Financial Services, etc. Some of the top recruiters of Birla Institute of Management Technology in 2025 include Accenture, Capgemini, TCS, Infosys, Alstom Group, Cognizant, Go Digit, etc.

The top job profiles offered to Marketing specialization batch 2025 include Senior Analyst/Analyst, Analyst Research, Management Trainee, Digital Government Analyst, Research Associate, etc. On the other hand, the top job profiles offered to Finance students include Investment Banking, Private Equity, Risk & Quantitative Analysis, Consultant, Account Management, etc. The top job profiles offered to Insurance specialization students include Data Scientist Insurance Analyst, Business Consulting, Risk Analyst, Associate Consultant & Associate Business Analyst, etc.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. There is Wi-Fi on campus and hostel premises. The quality of the food will satisfy everyone, not that of regular hostel food. The menu is good. Every day they serve good things.

reviews.review_heading: Reality of Birla Institute of Management Technology.
reviews.review_text: There are facilities like Bloomberg terminals, a fully Wi-Fi covered campus, and a hostel. The library is open till 11 p.m. M. There are refrigerators in every room, AC and heaters as well, and the same is true in the classrooms also.
