There is an AIC also which comes under Niti Aayog, which is very ...

reviews.review_heading: Good experience at BIMTECH.
reviews.review_text: BIMTECH provides good infrastructure. Classrooms have smart screens, which enhance the learning experience. The college provides seminar halls, IT/computer labs, an activity plaza, etc. Campus life at BIMTECH is also good. The campus provides amenities like a gym, basketball court, badminton court, cafeteria, tuck shop, and more.

reviews.review_heading: BIMTECH: the next best choice.
reviews.review_text: Four types of courses are provided: General, IB, IBM, and RM. The hostel is really good, the food especially. The menu changes every month, and salad and sweets are complimentary. Hygiene is well-maintained here, and you get both AC and a theater. The quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: Worth to take admission in BIMTECH.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in the college is the best. We have a big library that helps us stay updated with books and the newly constructed Bloomberg lab, which helps us get data for our study purposes. Along with the mess and canteen, which are very good, the infrastructure is totally worth it.

reviews.review_heading: The college to make you corporate ready!
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, with the hostel and mess facility being top notch, and extremely hygienic. The classes are equipped with smart boards and there are multiple computer labs, and other tools to facilitate learning. The infrastructure for extra-curriculars is also extensive, with basketball, volleyball, and badminton court available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and faculty. The internship process is smooth but it takes time.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, T.V., library, sitting room, microwave, lift, classroom, etc., are available. Talking about food, I have been in a hostel earlier, but the food is never up to mark, but in BIMTECH the food is actually decent, provided with everything right from salad to dessert. There are 4 meals given to students with non-veg included and different food and sitting areas for Jain students.

reviews.review_heading: BIMTECH is a good college for freshers. The average package is around 9-10 Lacs.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available in the college hostels, from AC to heaters in winter. We have full Wi-Fi connectivity on the entire campus. Two computer labs. A new Bloomberg lab has been started now. Well resource library is there. The facilities in the library are extremely amazing. Hostel rooms that are inside the campus are really good. The food, I would say, is amazing. We have a medical center as well. A lot of sports activities keep happening here throughout the year, like the BIMTECH Pr...

reviews.review_heading: Diverse culture, growth opportunities, ideal for postgrad focused students and fresher.
reviews.review_text: The college has all the necessary infra for students as well as faculty and staff. The entire campus and hostel are Wi-Fi enabled, and the college also tries to incorporate technology and sustainable practices on and off campus like smart screens, kiosks, biogas plants, and waste management systems, all of them being maintained regularly. The cleanliness has to be appreciated, especially at hostels; everyday cleaning is done along with laundry. Special requests are always taken into consideratio...

reviews.review_heading: Extremely happy about being able to join the best B school in India.
reviews.review_text: Courses are absolutely fantastic, we have a lot of facilities including Wi-Fi, all throughout the campus and hostel. Classrooms are fitted with smart boards and the library is open the entire day, sometimes up to 11:00 in the night so people can study and understand concepts better. We also have mess and canteen where food is provided and the menu is very diverse to accommodate all cultural aspects. Medical facilities are also fantastic. There are dedicated medical centers in all hostels and als...

reviews.review_heading: One of the best B-schools in North India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good in BIMTECH. The academic block has classrooms with smart boards and an environment conducive to learning. The library has a huge resource of books for its students with great ambiance to learn. The campus also has three hostels in it, all with great facilities. Out and out, BIMTECH has great infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Reality check of B-School: BIMTECH.
reviews.review_text: Compared with other top B-schools, the infrastructure is not the best. There are a lot of unnecessary restrictions on the campus and hostel. They have LAN cables in the hostel. You have to reach the campus by 7:30 p.m., which does not make sense in 2024. Canteen timing is until 11 pm only. The boys hostel is 2 km away from the campus and the canteen in the hostel has limited food items. Food quality compared with top schools is better but you won't find non-vegetarian foods. The medical staff is...

reviews.review_heading: Our campus is full of cultural diversity.
reviews.review_text: Our campus was Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms were air-conditioned. Single and double occupancy hostel rooms were available. Students will get medical insurance of Rs.5000 and a refundable security amount of Rs.50000. The mess fee structure was Rs 66,000. The hostel fee structure was Rs 96,000. One could refer to the student handbook for all information related to rules and regulations available on the website. The food served in the mess was good. There was an online registration process for the hos...

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good placements, infrastructure, and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available in this college. Digital classrooms are available. It has a computer laboratory. There is a decent library in this college. Atal Incubation Center is available for entrepreneurs. Hostels are very good. The food quality is better.

reviews.review_heading: Best business school in north India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well managed. The campus is surrounded by different varieties of trees and plants. The food quality is mostly good. Many options are provided for different requirements of students. The menu for each month is decided by the student-run committee.

college_info.intro:
MNIT Jaipur comprises 14 departments, including Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Department of Electrical Engineering, and Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Engineering, among others. MNIT Jaipur offers many UG, PG, and PhD courses.
The BTech and MTech programmes offered at MNIT Jaipur, are very popular among students. The institute provides a four-year BTech programme and a two-year MTech programme in numerous branches. MNIT Jaipur aims at the holistic development of students and helps them to develop technical competencies as well as various soft skills required to target core-industry roles.
The industry-institute relations established by MNIT Jaipur provide students with the opportunity to undergo many training programs organised by industry partners. MNIT Jaipur also offers placement assistance to students and helps them get placed in good companies. The notable MNIT Jaipur recruiters include Zomato, Amazon, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and Google, among others. review_content.Placements: Almost 85–90 percent of students from this Mechanical Engineering batch got placed, the highest package offered is 24 LPA, the median and average package is around 10 LPA, the minimum package is 5–6 LPA, students who get on-campus internships are very few, almost 18–20 percent, and the top recruiters are BPCL, HPCL, JPMC, BNY, and Amazon.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities available are quite good in terms of Wi-Fi, electricity, classrooms, and libraries, but for hostels the mess is the worst part as the food is of very low standard and we have to manage by taking food from the canteen sometimes, although some government hostels are good in terms of food quality.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Highly impressed by the faculty members.

review_content.Placements: Around 96 students are placed out of 108 students enrolled last time. The highest package offered is by JPMC, which offered a package of 27 LPA, while the average stood at 13 LPA with the lowest at 4.6 LPA. Top recruiters include JPMC, L&T, Honda, Tata, etc., and other PSUs like BPCL, HPCL, BEL, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: We had a nice infrastructure as this institute is an institute of national interest. The most famous building includes Vivekananda Lecture Theatre Complex (VLTC), which is also Asia's biggest lecture theatre. All labs are advanced in my department with certain labs for conventional manufacturing too. You will find a 24*7 Wi-Fi facility in the whole campus. Hostel forms another joy of life. We had a lot of fun in the hostel. Food in hostel is around average, but friendship is a must to order food from outside.

review_summary.college_name: MNIT Jaipur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: MNIT is the best college.

content.Placements: Almost 80 percent of students got placed on this campus. The highest package offered is 64 LPA. The lowest package offered is 10 LPA. The average package offered is 15 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Qualcomm, Flipkart, Amazon, etc. Almost 50 percent of students got internships in their 3rd year.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is so good. 24-hour Wi-Fi is provided. Labs and classrooms are big enough. The library is so big and so many books are available related to general knowledge and others. The quality is acceptable. The food in the mess is good, but South people cannot accept the food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college. Excellent infrastructure and facilities provided here.

content.Placements: 60 percent of the students got placed in Civil Engineering. The highest was 20 LPA, the lowest I don't know, and the average is 8 LPA. JPMC: ten percent got into JPMC, and 5 percent got into project planning and design. Management programs were offered as well.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available, but only LAN Wi-Fi is available in the hostel of the first-year students (i.e., Arawali Hostel), and wireless Wi-Fi is available for other students. The library is also very good recently built with top-notch infrastructure and good seating capacity, but it doesn't open at night. Mess food is average and okayish, but there is also a night canteen in Hostel 7 that has recently opened. Sports facilities are very good and provide all sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: MNIT Jaipur – College of national importance.

content.Placements: Almost 85–90 percent of students from this Mechanical Engineering batch got placed, the highest package offered is 24 LPA, the median and average package is around 10 LPA, the minimum package is 5–6 LPA, students who get on-campus internships are very few, almost 18–20 percent, and the top recruiters are BPCL, HPCL, JPMC, BNY, and Amazon.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities available are quite good in terms of Wi-Fi, electricity, classrooms, and libraries, but for hostels the mess is the worst part as the food is of very low standard and we have to manage by taking food from the canteen sometimes, although some government hostels are good in terms of food quality.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Highly impressed by the faculty members.

content.Placements: Around 96 students are placed out of 108 students enrolled last time. The highest package offered is by JPMC, which offered a package of 27 LPA, while the average stood at 13 LPA with the lowest at 4.6 LPA. Top recruiters include JPMC, L&T, Honda, Tata, etc., and other PSUs like BPCL, HPCL, BEL, etc.
content.Infrastructure: We had a nice infrastructure as this institute is an institute of national interest. The most famous building includes Vivekananda Lecture Theatre Complex (VLTC), which is also Asia's biggest lecture theatre. All labs are advanced in my department with certain labs for conventional manufacturing too. You will find a 24*7 Wi-Fi facility in the whole campus. Hostel forms another joy of life. We had a lot of fun in the hostel. Food in hostel is around average, but friendship is a must to order food from outside.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: MNIT Jaipur is the best NIT in North India.

content.Placements: Almost 80% of students get placed in our college. The highest package is 1 crore, the lowest package is 12 LPA, and the average package is 20 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Amazon, Flipkart, Qualcomm, and others. Almost 40% of students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: Our hostels are old but look okay. The infrastructure is very good. There are many classrooms and one big library that contains a lot of books related to subjects and others. There are almost 17 hostels for both boys and girls.

Earlier, the NIT placement 2024 session concluded at MNIT Jaipur with 540 UG and 186 PG students placed. The highest package offered was INR 64 LPA and was made to UG students. The highest package offered during PG placements 2024 was INR 33.06 LPA. The average package recorded during UG and PG placements in 2024 was INR 11.06 LPA and INR 10.28 LPA.

faqs.question: What is the placement process at MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The step-by-step MNIT Jaipur placement process is listed below: Students register for the placement session P&T cell invites companies for internships and placements Interested companies contact P&T cell and submit JNF/ INF for the profiles offered Announcement of available job offers as per JNF/ INF by P&T cell Company registration by the interested students Eligibility check by P&T cell as per JNF requirements Notification of eligible student list Slot allotment to the company as per availability Selection process by the company Announcement of the selection results

About 186 students were placed in the MNIT Jaipur PG Placements in 2024.

faqs.question: What is the cost of studying MBA at MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: As per the unofficial sources, MNIT Jaipur MBA fee for MBA course is INR 2 lakh. This is tuition fee is calculated as per the first-year fee and the amount can vary. The hostel charges are up to INR 1.43 lakh and a one-time fee of INR 18,300 is also added to the total fee. Candidates have to pay a certain amount of fee at the time of admission. However, if students call off admission till the last date of cancellation of admission, their first-semester fee will be refunded after the applicable deducting processing charges. Further, the given fee is as per unofficial sources. Candidates can visit the institute's website for more details around MNIT Jaipur MBA fee.

faqs.question: What is the fees for BArch course at MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The B.Arch course fee at MNIT Jaipur is INR 6.25 L. Candidates need to fulfil the eligibility requirement for admissions. The eligibility requirement for MNIT Jaipur admissions is that candidates should have passed Class 12 with a min of 50% aggregate. The entrance examinations accepted include JEE Main NATA & DASA UG.

description: MNIT Jaipur cutoff 2025 for BTech, MTech, and other courses are available on this page. Candidates preparing for the next academic session can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the MNIT Jaipur JEE Main cutoff 2025 along with other exams for different courses, rounds, and categories. Further exam-related updates are below:

In this section, candidates can view the last nine years of MNIT Jaipur JEE Main cutoff ranks for various courses and categories by clicking on the download now links provided below to understand the past years' trends.

MNIT Jaipur JEE Main cutoff 2025 for the first and last rounds are tabulated below for the General AI category students. In the last round, the MNIT Jaipur CSE cutoff 2025 was 5995 in the General category belonging to the AI quota. For other core branches, such as ECE and Mechanical, the JEE Main last round closing ranks for admission were 10827 and 25728, respectively for the General category. The cutoff ranks for core BTech branches are usually on the lower side, indicating competitive cutoff

For the General AI category students, the MNIT Jaipur B.E. / B.Tech cutoff 2025 ranged between 5995 and 38727 in the last round. Considering the lowest cutoff ranks of 5995 and 7921, B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering were the top two most competitive branches for admission among the students belonging to the General category.

JEE Main is the accepting exam for admission to the BTech and other UG courses. Qualified candidates are then eligible for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling process for final seat allocation. In this section, aspirants can find out all the important JEE Main 2026 dates to be eligible for admission.

JoSAA counselling 2025 is now over for admission to the Engineering courses offered at MNIT Jaipur. In 2025, the JoSAA counselling was conducted for up to six rounds. Further counselling rounds were conducted by CSAB to fill the vacant seats. Students who appeared for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling rounds can refer to the table below to view or download the round- and year-wise JEE Main cutoff lists for BTech admission at MNIT Jaipur to understand the cutoff trends.

Tabulated below are the BTech specialisations available for admission based on the last round closing ranks of JEE Main. This will help students to make an informed decision to get the right college and specialisation for admission. The options below are available for students belonging to the General AI quota and are in the range of the most competitive BTech specialisation of MNIT Jaipur. To refine their searches, students can also use the provided filters.

As per the GATE cutoff 2025, the top two most challenging M.E./M.Tech specialisations were M.Tech. in Computer Engineering and M.Tech. in Computer Science and Information Security with last round cutoff scores of 639 and 597, respectively, for the General AI quota. In the table below, candidates can view the branch-wise first and last round cutoff scores.

Tabulated below are the GATE CCMT last round cutoff scores for 2025, 2024 and 2023 across different rounds, categories and quotas. For the General AI quota, the last round cutoff scores varied between 350 and 639. While for the OBC category students, the final round cutoff scores were concluded between the range of 298 and 582 in the AI quota.

Candidates can refer to the table below to view some of the important GATE 2026 dates to be eligible for admission to the ME/MTech course. GATE is the accepting exam, followed by the CCMT counselling process for admission.

Tabulated below are the GATE cutoff lists across different rounds and years for ME/MTech admission at MNIT Jaipur - Malaviya National Institute of Technology. The consolidated cutoff list will help students understand the past years cutoff trends.

MNIT Jaipur CCMN cutoff 2025 concluded with the release of the final seat allotment result for MSc/MSc Tech courses. M.Sc. in Applied Mathematics turned out to be the most competitive option with a lowest last round closing rank of 954 for the students belonging to the General AI quota. The easiest option for admission was M.Sc. in Applied Physics, as the admission cutoff was comparatively more relaxed for the students. The last round cutoff for the same specialisation was 1195.

CCMN is the centralised platform for admissions to the MSc and MSc (Tech Programmes) at NITs, IIEST Shibpur, and some CFTI institutes that accept the IIT JAM scorecard. This year, CCMN counselling was conducted for three regular rounds and two special rounds for MSc admission across different participating institutes. Candidates preparing for MNIT Jaipur admission can refer to the table below to view or download the year- and round-wise CCMN cutoff list.

Apart from JEE Main, MNIT Jaipur also offers admission to BTech courses through DASA UG. Going as per last year data, the closing ranks for MNIT Jaipur cutoff 2022 for BTech ranged between 478 and 657. Tabulated below are the year-wise ranks for MNIT Jaipur Cutoff 2023 for BTech admissions through DASA UG:

Considering the last round of MNIT Jaipur CCMT cutoff 2025, core M.E./M.Tech branches, including Computer Engineering and Computer Science and Information Security, witnessed higher cutoffs for admission, while branches such as VLSI Design and Embedded Systems had comparatively relaxed cutoff scores for admission in the General category under the AI quota.

Based on the rankings from NIRF, MNIT Jaipur outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have displayed instability in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2025, MNIT Jaipur climbed 5 ranks to #77 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, MNIT Jaipur climbed 1 rank to #42 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Management' category, the institute's ranks have ascended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, MNIT Jaipur climbed 6 ranks to #62 rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT is the best college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is so good. 24-hour Wi-Fi is provided. Labs and classrooms are big enough. The library is so big and so many books are available related to general knowledge and others. The quality is acceptable. The food in the mess is good, but South people cannot accept the food.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college. Excellent infrastructure and facilities provided here.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available, but only LAN Wi-Fi is available in the hostel of the first-year students (i.e., Arawali Hostel), and wireless Wi-Fi is available for other students. The library is also very good recently built with top-notch infrastructure and good seating capacity, but it doesn't open at night. Mess food is average and okayish, but there is also a night canteen in Hostel 7 that has recently opened. Sports facilities are very good and provide all sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT Jaipur – College of national importance.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available are quite good in terms of Wi-Fi, electricity, classrooms, and libraries, but for hostels the mess is the worst part as the food is of very low standard and we have to manage by taking food from the canteen sometimes, although some government hostels are good in terms of food quality.

reviews.review_heading: Highly impressed by the faculty members.
reviews.review_text: We had a nice infrastructure as this institute is an institute of national interest. The most famous building includes Vivekananda Lecture Theatre Complex (VLTC), which is also Asia's biggest lecture theatre. All labs are advanced in my department with certain labs for conventional manufacturing too. You will find a 24*7 Wi-Fi facility in the whole campus. Hostel forms another joy of life. We had a lot of fun in the hostel. Food in hostel is around average, but friendship is a must to order food...

reviews.review_heading: MNIT Jaipur is the best NIT in North India.
reviews.review_text: Our hostels are old but look okay. The infrastructure is very good. There are many classrooms and one big library that contains a lot of books related to subjects and others. There are almost 17 hostels for both boys and girls.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT Jaipur- The best NIT.
reviews.review_text: The classes are very big with a capacity of more than 120 students. College infrastructure is from 19th century so it might look as old but the buildings are stronger than the present ones. Hostel mess and canteens are available including a night canteen.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT is the best NIT in India.
reviews.review_text: Here the classrooms are very big with a capacity of 120 students. Labs are also big. The library is very big with many books related to the course and general knowledge. Facilities in the hostel are good. Hostel mess and canteen are available. 24/7 medical facilities are also available. The grounds are very big for every sport.

reviews.review_heading: Campus with the best college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, a lush green campus with separate departments and a big hall for lectures, and it has Asia's biggest lecture hall. When it comes about hostels, they are good enough, but the food in the hostels is not at all good, the worst food.

reviews.review_heading: Great college if you want both great placements and a good college life.
reviews.review_text: We get free Wi-Fi everywhere, infrastructure is great, our lecture complex is very huge, in fact, the biggest in Asian, hostel facilities are great as well, with high speed internet and single rooms from the second year onwards. There are ample sports facilities as well.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT, Jaipur - The top NIT in northern part of India.
reviews.review_text: Here, there are so many facilities like library, labs, and classrooms. Hostel, canteens, and night canteen are also available. The quality of the food is okay, and the taste of the food does not satisfy Southern people. There are so many clubs related to sports, dance, and finance.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT Jaipur is one of the Best NITs in India.
reviews.review_text: As the college was built in the 2000s, the infrastructure is from ancient times, but the buildings are stronger than the new ones. The food in the hostel and canteens is okay, but it doesn't satisfy the taste of Southern people. They have to adjust. There are so many clubs for dance, finance, sports, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with college and faculty, good placements. Infrastructure and maintenance are good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and college facilities are good. You would be given Ethernet in the hostel and common Wi-Fi in college. It's totally a veg campus. The food in some of the hostels is not good. The infrastructure in the hostels is good. New hostels are in process. Got a large cricket and football ground.

reviews.review_heading: MNIT is one of the best colleges.
reviews.review_text: The labs are big enough. The classrooms are very large, and the library is also very big. The food quality in both the mess and canteen is excellent, but it can't satisfy the taste of the South side. Every week, a doctor is available. There are so many clubs related to sports, skills, dance, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in Rajasthan.
reviews.review_text: MNIT Jaipur has the largest lecture theatre complex in Asian known as VLTC, which provides digital classroom facilities with air-conditioning and projectors. There are many hostels for students. Quality of food is also very good, and mostly sports are available at the college.

reviews.review_heading: Value of money and many things to explore .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good with all the basic need available in college. The only problem in hot summer, the hostel is good but mess ***, sport facility are awesome and medical facilities are also decent the hostel is good but bathroom need to improved .

paragraphs: MNIT Jaipur awards scholarships to deserving UG and PG students on the basis of various eligibility criteria. Most of these scholarships are offered to Reserved category students such as SC/ ST/ OBC and Differently-Abled students. However, the institute provides scholarships to the General category students as well. Not only this, but MNIT Jaipur also awards various state-level scholarships to post-merit students. These scholarships are awarded to deserving students by the respective State Governments. Below mentioned are some of the scholarship schemes and the respective eligibility criteria:
Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC students (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, New Delhi)
Total family income is up to INR 8 LPA (for SC students), JEE rank
National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST students (CSSS Top Class ST students)
Total family income up to 6 LPA (for ST students), JEE Advanced
Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Students Belonging to Minority Communities (Ministry of Minority Affairs, New Delhi)
Minimum 50% aggregate at senior secondary (Class 12), merit-based
Post-matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
40% and above disabled with a valid certificate
Scholarships for Education for students with disabilities
80 % or above in Class 12, total family income is up to INR 8 lakh per annum
Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme For Central Armed Police Forces And Assam Rifles
Ward of deceased CAPF/ AR personnel

overview_faqs.question: Is Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences a good college for MBA?
overview_faqs.answer: The main focus of SIMATS is its engineering, dental, and medical programs. The MBA programme is not as well-known or reputable as its other programs, despite that fact. Following are the points you can keep in mind before admission to MBA at SIMATS. AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education) has granted SIMATS accreditation, and the university Saveetha is associated with it. Nevertheless, it lacks international accreditations that MBA candidates frequently pursue, like as AACSB or EQUIS. Rankings: According to well-known journals like Business Today, The Week, and Economic Times, SIMATS does not rank among the best MBA programs in India.SIMATS might offer a respectable MBA education, but if you're searching for a top MBA programme with good placement rates, strong industry contacts, and a global reputation, it might not be the ideal option.

overview_faqs.question: Does Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences refund fees?
overview_faqs.answer: Several salient features of Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences' return policy are: The majority of the institute's programs, including MBBS, BDS, B.Tech, and others, have clear return policies. After deducting administrative fees, funds are reimbursed to students who opt to withdraw their acceptance prior to the final day of admission. Usually, 1-2 weeks after classes begin, the deadline for admissions is reached. The following guidelines will apply to refunds in the event that a student departs after the final admissions date: Refundable 75% of fees if departure occurs within 30 days before the deadline (registration expenses excluded). Refundable 50% of fees if departure occurs within 30 to 90 days. If you depart after the final admittance date, you won't get a refund. A refund application must be completed.

The hostel needs some improvement and the canteen foods are so good that they are just like in restaurants but a little high cost. The library is good but can keep the books that can be taken and read by the students but the books are locked in the library.

reviews.review_text: Our college has one of the best infrastructures. Every classroom is provided with good tables and chairs, and each classroom has fans and AC. Wi-Fi is available inside the college premises. There are many hostels in our college, separate for boys and girls. Each college coming under our university has different hostels. Mess and canteen food are not up to the mark, but it's fine. Our college gives more importance to sports and other extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: My college experience at SIMATS .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is top-notch. You will have air-conditioned classrooms, Wi-Fi facilities are there, a library, etc. In a hostel, you have 2 sharing, 4 sharing, and 12 sharing rooms with AC facilities. Mess and canteen foods are available. If you want to hike, there are so many places on campus.

reviews.review_heading: SIMATS: the more you explore, the more you know.
reviews.review_text: Every hostel has Wi-Fi. The infrastructure of this college is more attractive than expected. The classrooms are so clean and hygienic. The hostel is also so good. On our campus, there are more than 15 hostels. Every hostel has its own uniqueness, like 4 in 1 AC, 6 in 1 AC,  8 in 1 AC, and 2 in 1 AC and there are non-AC rooms in hostels. The food is better than any other college in Chennai.

reviews.review_heading: Top notch infrastructure and facilities, excellent campus life, average food quality.

Wi-Fi is available 24 hours a day, and a projector is available for all classes. The labs are air-conditioned and well-cleaned. The library is very big, and it consists of all kinds of books related to your studies. Canteen food is above average, and a food court is available, but the management is poor. The quality of food is average.

reviews.review_heading: Saveetha college experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is excellent, with all the basic and top-end facilities available in our college. There are separate laboratories for each and every department and there are different labs for each further division in each department. Wi-Fi is available for the students. There are 4 libraries in our college with a great atmosphere to study in. There are many hostels in our college (approximately 10), and each hostel has its own rules and regulations. Food is comparatively bette...

reviews.review_heading: Really satisfied with all the facilities provided by our college management.
reviews.review_text: Excellent facilities were offered by the college management. The quality of food will be very good, the classroom infrastructure is also good. Medical facilities were also good. Labs, classrooms infrastructure were also good. The facilities is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in Chennai.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms have all the facilities with smart amenities. The infrastructure of the college is excellent. There were Library, Laboratories, Seminar halls, etc. and all of them were well maintained. The college campus has Wi-Fi facilities. The food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good place to gain and expand your knowledge and future but dissatisfied to the core in other areas.
reviews.review_text: I am a day scholar but my friends who reside in hostels weren't satisfied either. They showed me a picture of dead bugs and worms in their food. That alone is a major concern. No action was taken by the management related to the quality of the food provided. That explains a lot. The rooms are okay but not worth it. INR 80–90k in hostel fees is too much for a mediocre room and disease-carrying food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences, Poonamallee.
reviews.review_text: Facilities were decent. Our campus was Wi-Fi enabled. Computers were also available in this college. Laboratories were excellent. There was a decent library in this college. Hostel facilities were great. The security facility was good in our hostel. The food quality was decent. Sports were conducted in this college. Medical facilities were also provided for emergency purposes. Hospital was also available on our campus.

Amritsar IIM offers postgraduate, doctoral, and various other programmes to students. These programmes are provided across the Management and several other streams. overview_faqs.question: Is IIM Amritsar worth joining for MBA?

admission_overview.title: IIM Amritsar Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: IIM Amritsar admissions 2026 are based on entrance exam scores. IIM Amritsar is renowned for its 2-year full-time flagship MBA course. Admission to the MBA course is based on the CAT entrance exam scores. The CAT percentage for IIM Amritsar has been 95 for the past 2 years. This indicates a competitive kind of the selection process. The percentage also shows that students must be among top 5% of all CAT test-takers to join the MBA course of IIM Amritsar. IIM Amritsar admission cycle starts with CAT registration. Besides, the institute also offers Executive MBA, IPM, MSc and PhD courses. The selection for these courses is based on an institute-level entrance exam or other selection rounds. Below is the overview of IIM Amritsar admission process for its flagship MBA programme:

If getting into MBA programme is your dream, you must have a good CAT score. Being the flagship programme of IIM Amritsar, admission to the MBA is quite competitive. Apart from entrance exam, candidates also have to performance well in the personal interview round for MBA and Executive MBA programmes. paragraphs: IIM Amritsar admission processbegins with filling theCAT application formfor the MBA. For other programmes, students must apply on the official site of the college. The selection criteria may differ course-wise. Below is theIIM Amritsar admission process:

Candidates who wish to get admission in the courses available at the IIM Amritsar can apply for CAT examination by completing the CAT application process. This can be done by paying the complete application fee ofINR 2,400(for UR candidates) &INR 1,200(for reserved categories).
For other programmes, aspirants must fill out theIIM Amritsar form. Below is the course-wiseIIM Amritsar form fee:

IIM Amritsar offers admission to its flagship programme MBA based on CAT score. Once theCAT resultsandCAT cutoffare out, the candidates are shortlisted for the PI round. During the interview, the panel will evaluate each candidate's academic background, quality of work experience and other personal traits.

The final ranking list of candidates for admission to the MBA 2026 programme will be based on the composite score. The composite score includes the PI score and the Post PI score. The post-PI score for each candidate is calculated based on the aggregate scores obtained in PI, work experience, gender diversity and academic diversity. The pre-PI score is calculated based on the CAT score, academic performance, gender diversity and work experience.

The final offers of admission to candidates selected from each category will be made strictly based on the final rank based on the aggregate score. Selected candidates are required to confirm their seat in IIM Amritsar by paying the course fee.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 96 percent of students were placed in our course. The highest package offered was 26,00,000. The average package ranged from 12,00,000 to 16,00,000, and the lowest was approximately 10,00,000 to 12,00,000. All students got internships. review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available at our college are very good. The college has a very big campus, which is lush green. There is Wi-Fi all around the campus. reviews_list.review_title: It is a decent MBA college with good infrastructure and placements.

review_content.Placements: As an ex-member of the placement committee, I can say that the placements here are decent. At the end of the programme, apart from maybe a handful of students, all got placed. The highest salary package was around 24 LPA. The lowest salary package could be around 6-7 LPA, and the average salary package is around 12–14 LPA. Arctium, GEP, De Shaw, Infosys, Accenture, and 100+ companies attend our college for the placement process. Around 100% of students got internship opportunities, and many of them got offers from finance firms, market research firms, and consulting firms like Michael Page, GEP, Digit Insurance, Tata Motors, etc. The top roles that were offered for our course are management consultant, analyst, business analyst, project manager, team lead, key account manager, etc.

reviews_list.review_title: I would like to go back and live that time always and forever, and the experience is good.

Viacom18, Mckinsey, Salesforce, GoDigit, Axis Bank, etc., were the companies to watch out for. Around 70-80% of students got internships because students themselves opt-out mostly.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel will always be the place, and one should experience personal growth while being in that type of collaborative environment. It also helps one of the biggest take-aways from MBA, i.e, networking. The Wi-Fi was slow but manageable. Laboratories and libraries were resourceful enough. The food in the hostel was very inconsistent and seems distasteful a lot of times. The morning and evening snacks were always the ones to watch out for. The medical facilities were decent however no emergency and medical facilities were available. Somaiya has always been widely involved in sports and games, and hence, the college offers ample opportunities for it.

review_summary.college_name: K J Somaiya Institute of Management Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The best decision of my life I had taken for myself.

content.Placements: Almost the complete batch was placed. The highest package was more than 20 LPA, and the lowest was around 8 LPA. The average was around 15 LPA. Top companies were AbInbev, ITC, Wells Fargo, and JPMorgan. Almost everyone got an internship, and the most sought-after roles were marketing and product manager.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms were amazing with Wi-Fi, smart boards, and AC. We had Bloomberg terminals, too. It was very helpful in our learning. Our hostel was amazing too, with really good food. We had all the possible sports courts available to us. The sports culture at KJSIM is really good.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Full review of KJ somaiya institute of management.

content.Placements: I am not sit for placement but I far as I known placement is satisfactory. There is benefits like college is in Mumbai; more companies visit here than in Tier 2 cities. Companies like Deloitte, KPMG, HDFC bank and Amazon visit for placement. The highest package offered is around INR 27 lacs, while the average package is INR 14 lacs. The placement percentage is usually high, near 90%, in which many students build their own businesses, some pursuing higher education in foreign countries. Internships are given in the second semester. I selected Primewise Consulting for an HR intern. This company has tried with the college for internship .

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Kj Somaiya's MBA is the best.

content.Placements: Approximately 96 percent of students were placed in our course. The highest package offered was 26,00,000. The average package ranged from 12,00,000 to 16,00,000, and the lowest was approximately 10,00,000 to 12,00,000. All students got internships. The top roles offered were in finance or financial research, as well as in marketing. There are many roles, so I can't mention a single one and others.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available at our college are very good. The college has a very big campus, which is lush green. There is Wi-Fi all around the campus. There are around 10 to 15 canteens all over the campus, and they serve pure vegetarian food of very nice quality.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: It is a decent MBA college with good infrastructure and placements.

content.Placements: As an ex-member of the placement committee, I can say that the placements here are decent. At the end of the programme, apart from maybe a handful of students, all got placed. The highest salary package was around 24 LPA. The lowest salary package could be around 6-7 LPA, and the average salary package is around 12–14 LPA. Arctium, GEP, De Shaw, Infosys, Accenture, and 100+ companies attend our college for the placement process. Around 100% of students got internship opportunities, and many of them got offers from finance firms, market research firms, and consulting firms like Michael Page, GEP, Digit Insurance, Tata Motors, etc. The top roles that were offered for our course are management consultant, analyst, business analyst, project manager, team lead, key account manager, etc.

individual_reviews.course: - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I would like to go back and live that time always and forever, and the experience is good.

content.Placements: Around 100% of students were placed. The highest salary package offered was 30 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 5 LPA. The average salary package offered was 8 LPA. For marketing, top roles mostly were into the sales side followed by branding and marketing. Advertising and media management roles were very few. Viacom18, Mckinsey, Salesforce, GoDigit, Axis Bank, etc., were the companies to watch out for. Around 70-80% of students got internships because students themselves opt-out mostly.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel will always be the place, and one should experience personal growth while being in that type of collaborative environment. It also helps one of the biggest take-aways from MBA, i.e, networking. The Wi-Fi was slow but manageable. Laboratories and libraries were resourceful enough. The food in the hostel was very inconsistent and seems distasteful a lot of times. The morning and evening snacks were always the ones to watch out for. The medical facilities were decent however no emergency and medical facilities were available. Somaiya has always been widely involved in sports and games, and hence, the college offers ample opportunities for it.

reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available at our college are very good. The college has a very big campus, which is lush green. There is Wi-Fi all around the campus. There are around 10 to 15 canteens all over the campus, and they serve pure vegetarian food of very nice quality.

reviews.review_heading: It is a decent MBA college with good infrastructure and placements.

The library is generally good enough for getting required books as well as serving as a study hall. Mess food isn't that great, it would definitely need some adjusting to it. The canteen food is great. There is an amazing synthetic running track, volleyball and football courts.

reviews.review_heading: I would like to go back and live that time always and forever, and the experience is good.

The food in the hostel was very inconsistent and seems distasteful a lot of times. The morning and evening snacks were always the ones to watch out for. reviews.review_heading: Most of the factors of our college are quite good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for MCA aspirants.

reviews.review_text: Classrooms are in good condition with full facilities. Labs and library are properly provided. Hostel facility is normal. Canteen and mess food is good in comparison to other nearby college and hostels. Medical and sports facilities are available in good form.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college with all the facilities available and makes the students industry ready.

The hostel facility is also available with reasonable prices and huge space and mess being outsourced to one of the best caterers of Mumbai. reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for this course.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college life at KJ Somaiya Institute of Management.

The quality of food is really good which take care of the hygiene part too. The college has qualified doctors for regular health checkup along with an ambulanc...

reviews.review_heading: Very good placements, Faculties are experienced, facilities are good and hostels and mess is nice.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very impressive and equipped with various facilities such as Wi-Fi with 24hr internet connection and well equipped labs and libraries for specific departments. Class rooms are big and has projectors for better understanding and hostels are very well equipped with internet facilities and food served here is delicious and also medical facilities are good.

Siksha 'o' Anusandhan course admissions for various UG and PG courses of Engineering is done through either SAAT or various national-level entrance exams. Further, the university releases merit lists for students who got qualified in the respective entrance exams. faqs.question: What is the hostel fee structure of SOA University?
faqs.answer: The hostel fee structure for SOA University depends upon the number of accommodations, for double sharing with Air conditioning the fee is INR 1.20 Lacs per annum. For triple-sharing rooms with Air conditioning, the fee is INR 90,000 per annum. Siksha O Anusandhan University provides separate hostels for boys and girls with 24-hour security and Wi-Fi facilities. There are 13 boys and 11 girls hostel. The hostels also have mess facilities providing hygienic and nutritious food. The mess charges are not included in the hostel fee, candidates need to pay INR 36,000 per annum to avail of the campus mess.

faqs.question: What is the total fees of SOA BTech programme?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for the BTech programme at SOA University ranges between INR 5.1 Lakhs - INR 11 lakhs. This range of fees does not include the cost of the mess or the hostel fee. There is a range in the fee structure because the fee for each specialisation can be slightly different from the other. The BTech programme at SOA University is also provided as a three-year lateral entry programme and in this case, the candidates will not have to pay for the first year of the prgramme. The fee mentioned here is taken from unofficial sources and can be indicative.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, okay placement.
reviews.review_text: In our institute, we have smart classrooms with a good internet connection. Our labs and library are very good, and the classrooms are well air-conditioned. Our hostel food is very nice, and we have good sanitation in our hostel. Wi-Fi is available but not too fast.

reviews.review_heading: Good, but if you do not take the risk of money, then come to study here. Otherwise, very good.

The hostel infrastructure is also good and study-friendly. The faculty are good. For machine learning, high-quality labs are provided. In the library, the behavior of teachers is good and very friendly. Free medicine and minor treatment are provided by SUM IMS, SOA. No functions are organized by the college except for the annual function, but many smaller events are organiz...

reviews.review_heading: I chose the best inter for real.
reviews.review_text: The environment is so friendly. There are clean and neat classrooms. There is AC in every single class. The professors are friendly and understanding. The hostel is good, but the mess food is not that great. If you get into the habit, you will learn to adjust. The environment is so friendly.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best things about the university is that ragging is strictly prohibited on campus.
reviews.review_text: The biggest relief here is that almost all our classrooms are air-conditioned. For CSE, the labs are pretty solid, and we have dedicated labs. Most PCs have decent i5/i7 processors and run the necessary software without lagging. You get plenty of lab time, but strict attendance is maintained. There are multiple hostels for boys and girls. They are separate. You can choose between AC and Non AC rooms. The rooms are generally clean and tidy. Bathrooms are cleaned daily.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of job opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is great, but the non-AC hostels are not that good. If you want to stay in good condition, I recommend staying out of the college in a flat or PG. PGs are great there and very cheap. You can find lots of them. The library, Wi-Fi, and canteens are great, and there is no problem there.

reviews.review_heading: Definitely a good university in Odisha.
reviews.review_text: You will definitely like the infrastructure, and the food is 8.5/10, depending on your personal Taste. You should definitely try the Biriyani, which you will definitely like. Mostly, you will get a variety of food, and most of the time, the food is edible and properly cooked.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the Institute of Technical Education and Research.
reviews.review_text: There are very bad facilities, as they do not have any proper behavior. The food here is like they would give you food prepared under less hygienic conditions and leftover vegetables. The timing of the hostel is the worst. They treat our hostel like a ladies' hostel because our return timing is 7:00 PM.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is well organized. Professors are well qualified, and placement in the college is solid.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well organized. The labs are in perfect condition all the time, whether the Physics lab or the CSE labs. All have centralized AC and are perfect. The drainage system is fine inside the campus. The hostels are perfect as well (from a male perspective). The food is good. If you don't like the food, you can complain about it. At the end of the day, you will like the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: SOA is a mix of pros and cons.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure and good technical labs. Wi-Fi facility is available 24x7. All classrooms are smart. It also has a good central library where students can study. The hostel is not upto mark. Mess food is average. The hostel culture is also not that good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SOA University - Siksha 'O' Anusandhan.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good for safety issues. There is a good environment, but we have to face internet issues. Otherwise, everything is good, like cleaning. The food is average. Hostels are best for study and security. There is no ragging. It is under CCTV surveillance and always under monitoring conditions.

reviews.review_heading: College is good. They should conduct more events.
reviews.review_text: In our college, all the facilities are okay. The Wi-Fi speed is very slow and laggy. Classrooms and library are top notch not IIT level. Facilities quality is good. The quality of food is sometimes good sometimes not. Sports are also good over here and chances are given.

reviews.review_heading: Inter and Teach sounds weird.
reviews.review_text: I mean the Wi-Fi all over college, food , even the cafeteria and all are not pocket friendly. The medical facilities are nice and fine. Inter is well known for sports. Out of all 5 campuses, it has been maintaining the streak of being the SOA cup winners. We had a sports fest from Dec 4 - Jan 7th 2026. Even you have Inter College leagues, etc.

reviews.review_heading: An absolutely mediocre college with basic facilities but decent food and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel premises, but not in the library, which is disappointing. Labs and classrooms are decent. The library can be upgraded, but its alright. The quality of food is decent, better than what many other colleges offer. The hostel provides basic facilities. The campus does have a sports culture, but the area designed for sports related activities is quite small. Medical facilities are available. The college also hosts sports tournaments. I wi...

reviews.review_heading: Review of what a good experience was in my college life.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there were so many different types of courses available. Different courses had different blocks. Fully Wi-Fi available inside the college campus. Classrooms were smart rooms, and a big central library was also available on campus. In the hostel, they provided Wi-Fi, a gym, four times a day food, power backup, etc.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA at Jaipuria Lucknow - Jaipuria Institute of Management?
overview_faqs.answer: The fee of the Jaipuria Institute of Lucknow is a little bit high as compared to other colleges which is 3,67000.00 INR. for one year, as the MBA is a two year course so you have to pay a total of 7,34000.00 INR for your college feesRather than this their are some hidden charges like registration fees for each semester and such thing which you can expect around 15,000.00 INR. for two years.Though these numbers are just for the college fees, If you are not from a Lucknow, you really need a residence for atleast two years, you should also consider for your daily expenses.As MBA is a management course and it can not be completely done within the campus so you really need to visit the different places for exposure.So, ovearall, for a rough idea you need approximately 10-12 Lakhs for pursuing a MBA degree from Jaipuria Lucknow.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee for various courses offered by the Jaipuria Lucknow - Jaipuria Institute of Management?
overview_faqs.answer: Candidates willing to get admission to various courses must pay an application fee of INR 1,000 which is non-refundable. The total fee for PGDM is INR 13.5 lakh.

review_summary.college_name: Jaipuria Institute of Management Lucknow Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Financial Services - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good environment.

content.Placements: Overall placement is good. The institute has tie up with big and medium companies, start ups and unicorn. Also, the placement cell is very supportive towards building the career of the students. Companies like HCL, Deloitte, EY, Icici, SBI Purple, Darwinbox, Tata Chroma, Pantaloons, etc. offer placements.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are equipped with all the digital facilities like projector, Wi-Fi, and e-library. Environment is good. Hostel facilities are maintained. Food is also fine. Morning and evening snacks are tasty. Rooms are spacious with both single and double beds with air-conditioners and non-air-conditioners.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Best PGDM college in Lucknow in terms of faculty members and placements.

content.Placements: There are good number of companies that come for recruitment every year. The college has a structured placement cell that keeps track of every student and companies for placement purposes. Salary package ranges between 6-8 LPA on average. Management trainee is the most common role offered.
content.Infrastructure: A number of facilities are available in campus in terms of classrooms, Wi-Fi, library and hostel. The food quality is average and there is variety in canteen menu. Sports are encouraged through various indoor and outdoor sports setup. Medical facility is also there.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Placements offered are excellent.

content.Placements: Jaipuria offers top class placement in the best companies. Amazon, Tata AIG, Amul, Pantaloons and many other companies come for placements. Students can also apply for companies, in inter-campus. Average salary is around 6 LPA. The highest recorded has been approximately 18 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The campus facilities are great for students from the city and outside. Classrooms, Wi-Fi and hostel facility is available. Library has kindles as well for external sources of content. Food quality is good, Canteen is kept clean and fresh. Medical facility is available.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the college, If your score in CAT like exam is around 70, this is best choice.

content.Placements: Around 90 percent students got placed during the 2021 placements. Top recruiters includes HUL, ITC, Genpact, HCL etc. The highest package was around 12 lacs per annum, average I think was around 5 lpa, IT placement is usually high but due to pandemic, placements have come down.
content.Infrastructure: All the necessary facilities are provided by the college, they have separate hostel for both girls and boys. Hostel is equipped with all the facilities like Wi-Fi, gatekeeper, gym etc. Campus has all the facilities which is required for the b school.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: Jaipuria provides great placement assistance to the students. Courses are offered here are PGDM, PGDM retail and PGDM finance and there are good number of recruiters for each course. The highest package offered was around 18 Lacs per annum in Amazon. Infact, internship opportunity is also given in Amazon.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is fabulous. Even though it is not very huge, all the facilities are offered like any other B-school in country. Extra curricular is considered just as important as academic activities. Hostel facility is there for both girls and boys with good quality of food.

content.Placements: I am from the 2023-25 batch, and till now 93 students out of 401 students are placed, and still almost 1 year is left for placements. So it means this year placement is happening at a faster rate, and also companies are coming and recruiting in good numbers with good packages.
content.Infrastructure: The KIIT School of Management has a stunning campus with world-class infrastructure, abundant greenery, and beautiful stone structures that enhance the ambiance. In the evenings, the campus becomes a perfect place for students to relax and unwind from their busy schedules. The classrooms, library, and Wi-Fi are well equipped with the latest technology, making learning smooth and efficient. The infrastructure and overall environment make student life easy and engaging. Additionally, the campus offers world-class food, hostel services, medical facilities, and sports amenities. There are sports grounds and facilities available throughout the campus, promoting a balanced and active student life.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Completed MY MBA in KIIT.

content.Placements: Placement has been an added advantage at KIIT School of Management, both for summer internships and final placements. Almost all eligible students get decent offers, depending on their preparation. The highest package as of now for our batch stands at 14 Lacs annual for final placement. Companies such as Deloitte, KPMG, Bharat Financial, Protiviti, Dabur, Handiram, and Loreal come on a regular basis for recruitment. admission_process.title: KIIT School of Management Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: KIIT School of Management admission to all the UG & PG courses is entrance-based. The admission starts with an online registration process. To get admission to any of the UG & PG courses at KIIT School of Management, students must go through a multi-step admission process. Check the following steps for the complete details around KIIT School of Management admission:

KIIT School of Management application process is conducted in two ways for PG courses. Students can apply directly to the online application portal of the institute with valid scores of any one of the national-level entrance exam. Another way is to apply for the KIITEE Management entrance exam at (admissions.ksom.ac.in/kiitee management). The second application process is valid for all UG, PG & PhD courses.

KIIT School of Management admission to all courses is entrance-based. Students either need to qualify for the institute-level KIITEE or KIITEE Management Test. However, a valid score of other national-level entrance exams conducted for admission to UG, PG & Doctoral level courses are also accepted for admission to respective courses. The institute shortlists students based on their past academic records and entrance exam scores. The final selection will be based on the performance of candidates in Group Discussion and Personal Interview rounds.

After the completion of all the selection rounds, the final result will be declared on the official website of KIIT School of Management. Candidates who pass the selection process must submit a list of documents for the verification.

At last, students will be intimated for their final selection through a provisional offer letter. They need to confirm their offer with the terms and conditions for taking admission to the programme through an “Acceptance Letter”. Further, they must also pay the fee within the stipulated deadline to finalise the admission.

faqs.answer: A:    Aligarh Muslim University offers a three-year full-time BSc course at the undergraduate level. Apart from the BSc course, the University also offers BSc (Hons) courses. faqs.question: How many seats are there for AMU BSc course?

faqs.answer: A:    AMU has a pre-defined set of eligiblity criteria for admission to the various BSc specialisations that it provides. The eligibility crietra vary across the specialisations. In general, a candidate must have scored a minimum of 50% in Class 12 with relevant Science subjects to be eligible for BSc admission at AMU. The relevant subjects may vary depending upon the choice of specialisation. Further, candidates must not be more than 24 years old as of July 01 in the year of admission.
faqs.question: How can I know if I am eligible to apply for B.Sc admission at AMU?

faqs.answer: A:    For undergraduate admission to courses, including BA (Hons), BVoc and BSc (Hons) through CUET-UG, candidates must have a valid CUET-UG score. For BA (Hons) admission, candidates must have to attempt the Domain/ General/ Languages sections of CUET while appearing for the entrance test along with the minimum eligibility criteria set by AMU. Final selection for most of the UG and PG courses via CUET is based on candidates' performance in the counselling round. Talking about the minimum eligibility requirement for AMU UG courses, candidates must have passed the Class 12 with a minimum aggregate of 50%. For PG admission, graduation in any discipline with a minimum 50% aggregate is required. To know more about AMU course-wise eligibility, selection and fees, Click Here.
faqs.question: Who is eligible for AMU?

faqs.answer: A:    AMU offers MSc as a two-year postgraduate programme offered in the full-time mode. To be eligible to pursue MSc at AMU, candidates must have scored at least 55% in Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline. Hence, a candidate scoring less that 50% in their graduation degree is not eligible to apply for the programme. Such candidates can pursue MSc at some other college or university. They can also check out the colleges offering online MSc courses.

paragraphs: AMU Engineering and Management NIRF reports 2024, reports that the median package given to AMU BTech placements 2023 was INR 6 LPA , and for the MBA placements 2023, the median package stood at INR 5.26 LPA. With this the placement rate during Aligarh Muslim University placements 2023 for BTech was 82% and for MBA it was 84% .

Earlier, as per the media report, 5 students from the Faculties of Science, Life Science, Commerce and Engineering , Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) were selected by IB Global Academy , Gurugram as faculty members in the campus placement drive 2023. The highest package offered during AMU MBA placements 2023 stood at INR 14 LPA. Earlier, according to media reports, 11 BTech students have been placed during AMU placements 2022. Further, the highest package offered during AMU BTech placements 2022 stood at INR 21 LPA. The top recruiters of Aligarh Muslim University in 2022 included leading companies such as Forbes Marshall, Publicis Sapient, and Ramboll India.

nirf.description:
Based on the rankings from NIRF, AMU outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have displayed instability in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2025, AMU fell 3 ranks to #19 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking. Throughout the preceding two years, the rank has oscillated but is currently stable.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a fluctuating trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, AMU fell 2 ranks to #10 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Engineering' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, AMU fell 1 rank to #34 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
The institute's ranks in the 'Management' category; have shown a fluctuation when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, AMU climbed 1 rank to #69 rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking.

review_content.Placements: 100% of the students in our department were placed. The highest package offered was 8 lakhs per year, and the lowest was 3.30 lakhs per year. I got an internship with True Finance, and I'm now a financial analyst.

The college organized sports tournaments and competitions, which was very good for sports.

reviews_list.review_title: Great university with vibrant campus life.

review_content.Placements: There is a dedicated team for it who help the student throughout internships and placement. Almost everyone gets the placement if they are eligible and want to go for it. It all depends on how well students perform and are capable of cracking it.
review_content.Infrastructure: It has one of the best infrastructures, well maintained and student centric campus with well organized classrooms, AC, Wi-Fi, library, labsbloomberg terminals, study rooms, cafes, inside the campus, ending machines. Hostels are available for both boys and girls, single, double, triple and all kinds of rooms are available. Seminars, workshops, industrial visits, and events are conducted to keep students engaged and enhance their learning and also have different types of clubs.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (IOT) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It offers a good learning environment and strong placements.

review_content.Placements: The highest package offered is 60 LPA. The lowest package is from 3-4 LPA. The average package offered is 8 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are Amazon, Deloitte, KPMG, and Accenture. Many students also get internships in firms like IBM, HDFC Bank, and TCS, mainly in analyst, IT, finance, and consulting roles.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our course has good Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, updated labs, and a big library. Hostel rooms are clean, and the mess food is decent. Sports areas, a gym, and medical help are always available, which makes the campus overall comfortable. There is greenery in the hostel.

reviews_list.review_title: Everything here is well .

review_content.Placements: 25% to 50% students were placed LG, deloitte, dell Many internships Software developed, devops engineer Sales company also student were placed As per my knowledge my seniors are getting placed in good companies if you have skills you will be selected many companies visit our college to hire .
review_content.Infrastructure: The college provides very good and clean facilities. The hostel has many rooms, which are available in 1, 2, 3, and 4 sharing options. The food quality is not too bad; every day we have a variety of veg and non-veg. Overall, the food is manageable. The food facility in my college is good because we have many options, and once a day we will get non-veg, maybe at lunch or dinner. There will be food fest stuff, overall good.

reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the college and the campus.

review_content.Placements: About 85 percent students got placed and the top companies are like IBM, Urban Company.
review_content.Infrastructure: College life is very good. Campus is full of greenery and the campus is very beautiful. The hostel facilities are also good. Labs are well-equipped. Rooms are cleaned every week. Mess is also good here, they provide good food 4 times a day.
review_content.Faculty: Faculty members are good here and they are ready for one-on-one doubt discussion. They provide proper support. Exam papers are of good level. It provides all tests for all concepts covered.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Law (LL.B) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: It's a great college overall.

review_content.Placements: The placement cell is really good, as long as the students cooperate with the college and the placement cell. On record, the highest paid salary is 60 LPA. I know one of my seniors who is getting paid 80 LPA also. It completely depends on merit. EY is one of the top recruiting companies. They provide different ways to engage students in placement. If the student shows interest. Right now, I am going through a corporate mentorship where one of the top directors of a company comes to guide me and explain how vast my scope is.
review_content.Infrastructure: It's a green campus. Obviously, it's very calm and beautiful to be around. You get to see students from all over the world. The food is top-notch. They provide South Indian and North Indian food for the students. Non-veg food is provided almost every day.

reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied because of the faculty, good placements, really good infrastructure, and facilities.

review_content.Placements: The college is very good for placements, and almost 90% of students get placed every year. The highest package is more than 20 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. Top roles such as lawyers, advocates, associates, and civil judges are offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is so good, the college is filled with greenery, and there are facilities of CCTV, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. The quality of facilities in the hostel includes food and laundry facilities as well. Food quality is so good available in the mess and canteen. There is always a doctor available for medical purposes, and also there are different grounds and coaches available for games and sports, including all the facilities. The college also has a gymnasium, Zumba, and music and dance classes.
