review_summary.college_name: Alliance University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great university with vibrant campus life.

content.Placements: There is a dedicated team for it who help the student throughout internships and placement. Almost everyone gets the placement if they are eligible and want to go for it. It all depends on how well students perform and are capable of cracking it.
content.Infrastructure: It has one of the best infrastructures, well maintained and student centric campus with well organized classrooms, AC, Wi-Fi, library, labsbloomberg terminals, study rooms, cafes, inside the campus, ending machines. Hostels are available for both boys and girls, single, double, triple and all kinds of rooms are available. Seminars, workshops, industrial visits, and events are conducted to keep students engaged and enhance their learning and also have different types of clubs.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (IOT) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It offers a good learning environment and strong placements.

content.Placements: The highest package offered is 60 LPA. The lowest package is from 3-4 LPA. The average package offered is 8 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are Amazon, Deloitte, KPMG, and Accenture. Many students also get internships in firms like IBM, HDFC Bank, and TCS, mainly in analyst, IT, finance, and consulting roles.
content.Infrastructure: Our course has good Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, updated labs, and a big library. Hostel rooms are clean, and the mess food is decent. Sports areas, a gym, and medical help are always available, which makes the campus overall comfortable. There is greenery in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B TECH IN COMPUTER SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Everything here is well .

content.Placements: 25% to 50% students were placed LG, deloitte, dell Many internships Software developed, devops engineer Sales company also student were placed As per my knowledge my seniors are getting placed in good companies if you have skills you will be selected many companies visit our college to hire .
content.Infrastructure: The college provides very good and clean facilities. The hostel has many rooms, which are available in 1, 2, 3, and 4 sharing options. The food quality is not too bad; every day we have a variety of veg and non-veg. Overall, the food is manageable. The food facility in my college is good because we have many options, and once a day we will get non-veg, maybe at lunch or dinner. There will be food fest stuff, overall good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (AI and Future Technologies) (Kalvium) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college and the campus.

content.Placements: About 85 percent students got placed and the top companies are like IBM, Urban Company.
content.Infrastructure: College life is very good. Campus is full of greenery and the campus is very beautiful. The hostel facilities are also good. Labs are well-equipped. Rooms are cleaned every week. Mess is also good here, they provide good food 4 times a day.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are good here and they are ready for one-on-one doubt discussion. They provide proper support. Exam papers are of good level. It provides all tests for all concepts covered.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Law (LL.B) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It's a great college overall.

content.Placements: The placement cell is really good, as long as the students cooperate with the college and the placement cell. On record, the highest paid salary is 60 LPA. I know one of my seniors who is getting paid 80 LPA also. It completely depends on merit. EY is one of the top recruiting companies. They provide different ways to engage students in placement. If the student shows interest. Right now, I am going through a corporate mentorship where one of the top directors of a company comes to guide me and explain how vast my scope is.
content.Infrastructure: It's a green campus. Obviously, it's very calm and beautiful to be around. You get to see students from all over the world. The food is top-notch. They provide South Indian and North Indian food for the students. Non-veg food is provided almost every day.

paragraphs: The admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list or counselling, and other steps. Check below the Alliance University admission process:

The mode of application is online for all courses (apply.alliance.edu.in). Candidates must pay an application fee of INR 1,000 to apply for admission. Once the candidate completes the payment, aspirants will receive a notification email acknowledging the payment.

The applicant will have to select a date for their Alliance Selection process (A full-day immersion where students will solve real-life problems and be evaluated by a panel on their overall performance. It is designed to help and appreciate the candidature better and also provide a glimpse of the innovative approach to evaluation, teaching and learning.)

Once the Alliance Selection Process is completed, the Admissions team will evaluate every profile and results will be declared on the same day. Students can either be Selected, Waitlisted or Rejected*.
*Rejected students cannot apply to the same program in the same year.
Step 2.1: Alliance University PhD Admission Process

Candidates must sit and appear for the Alliance Research Aptitude Test for PhD course admissions. The application fee is INR 3,000. Once the candidates qualify for the entrance exam, they further need to sit for a personal interview + evaluation of the research synopsis on proposed dissertation work and other parameters such as scholastic and extracurricular records and work experience are used for admission. The final selection of the candidate will be based on the overall performance in the admission selection process.

All applications are reviewed by the selection committee. Candidates are evaluated based on the candidate’s performance in the national entrance exam or Alliance entrance exam, academic performance through school and college and their involvement in extra-curricular activities and the performance in various aspects on the selection day.

reviews.review_heading: Great university with vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: It has one of the best infrastructures, well maintained and student centric campus with well organized classrooms, AC, Wi-Fi, library, labsbloomberg terminals, study rooms, cafes, inside the campus, ending machines. Hostels are available for both boys and girls, single, double, triple and all kinds of rooms are available. Seminars, workshops, industrial visits, and events are conducted to keep students engaged and enhance their learning and also have different types of clubs.

reviews.review_heading: It offers a good learning environment and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: Our course has good Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, updated labs, and a big library. Hostel rooms are clean, and the mess food is decent. Sports areas, a gym, and medical help are always available, which makes the campus overall comfortable. There is greenery in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading:
Everything here is well 
.
reviews.review_text: The college provides very good and clean facilities. The hostel has many rooms, which are available in 1, 2, 3, and 4 sharing options. The food quality is not too bad; every day we have a variety of veg and non-veg. Overall, the food is manageable. The food facility in my college is good because we have many options, and once a day we will get non-veg, maybe at lunch or dinner. There will be food fest stuff, overall good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college and the campus.
reviews.review_text: College life is very good. Campus is full of greenery and the campus is very beautiful. The hostel facilities are also good. Labs are well-equipped. Rooms are cleaned every week. Mess is also good here, they provide good food 4 times a day.

reviews.review_heading: It's a great college overall.
reviews.review_text: It's a green campus. Obviously, it's very calm and beautiful to be around. You get to see students from all over the world. The food is top-notch. They provide South Indian and North Indian food for the students. Non-veg food is provided almost every day.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of the faculty, good placements, really good infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is so good, the college is filled with greenery, and there are facilities of CCTV, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. The quality of facilities in the hostel includes food and laundry facilities as well. Food quality is so good available in the mess and canteen. There is always a doctor available for medical purposes, and also there are different grounds and coaches available for games and sports, including all the facilities. The college also has a gymnasium, Zumba, and ...

reviews.review_heading: Alliance University, Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: College adds proper meals to the food menu of students, especially those studying in the hostels. They take too much care about the physical and mental health of the students. College also adds other physical activities like sports, library hours, and yoga classes to help relieve their stress.

reviews.review_heading: Alliance University B.Tech, is it absolutely worth studying here?
reviews.review_text: Everything is just amazing infrastructure-wise. I would suggest that it doesn't matter to you until you need it. So it is great here to take admission, and campus is so widespread. Infrastructure is good, food is better at college hostel mess, and there are many other food stalls on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Very bad faculty members but good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text:
Block is not good, 6 floors for every period. They change from one floor to another. I will say that BBA is good. I won't recommend it for B.Tech,
law is good. Some hostels are very bad and now this year they have built new hostels. I recommend better to take PG hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Here at Alliance, faculty members are good really, good infrastructure, and excellent college life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good. Hostels are also beautiful. Wi-Fi is available 24X7. The hostel food is good. They also conduct food festivals for a penny a month. They provide 4 times a day. Medical facilities are also good. There are many sports clubs, you can join any club.

reviews.review_heading: College is fun, and you can explore many things, but studies are more important here.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is too good, and the campus is also big. Facilities are good as well. You can access the library till 12 o’clock.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and good upcoming placements.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good. Wi-Fi is super on the entire campus. North and South food is available in the canteen. Classrooms have a good infrastructure. We will not see the library in our lives. The infrastructure is peaceful. It has everything for sports and games. It has a big ground to play and enjoy.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are good. The campus life is not that great. We do have events going on here.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good, and it is not like other colleges. The Mac lab is provided. We can go and work anytime we want. The library is open all the time. The security is really great. Classrooms have good ventilation and help to keep students seated for long hours.

reviews.review_heading: A really good college with great infrastructure and vibes.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good, I would say, as it is designed and architected in an amazing way. The college has a peaceful vibration and many plants and trees. You will get Wi-Fi coverage in every nook and corner of the college, except for the bathrooms. Talking of bathrooms, they are available almost every 100 meters and are very clean as well. There are a lot of games to play, football, badminton, cricket, tennis, table tennis, basketball, and much more.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college placements, and the infrastructure is really nice.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is quite good. The mess food is good compared to other mess food. There are various sports facilities available, with different coaches for different sports. There is a clinic inside the campus and an ambulance, which is available 24/7.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Marketing Management - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Life is amazing when I go to college.

content.Placements: I still remember that our batch size was 186 students with work experience ranging from 0 to 36 months. The highest package in our batch is the 26.2 LPA offered by DE Shaw Company. The top companies visiting campus are Hero Motors Co., Reliance Retail, Aditya Birla Retail, Accenture, and DHL Express. A summer internship is part of our curriculum, and I completed it at Airtel. The top roles offered are area sales manager and strategic consultant. The average package was 13 LPA, and the top 20% got above 20 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is sufficiently large and situated in the center of Hyderabad city, where many businesses are close to the campus, making it simpler for them to come for hiring. From now on, Metro is also available for transport. College Wi-Fi and WLAN are available everywhere. The digital classroom and digital library are both in college. This PGDM program is residential so a hostel is compulsory. Each student gives a single room; however, there isn't space for bathrooms in corridors. It typically has 40 rooms on each floor of the of the building, which is four stories but has no elevator. Cleanliness and good service are up to the mark.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides good placements, a good ROI, and a good campus life.

content.Placements: About 98% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 25 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 9 LPA. The average salary package offered is 12 LPA. Top companies that come here for placements are Reliance Retail, EY, Hero Motocorp, HCL, Wipro, and Schindler Electric. All students got internships in good companies like BlueStar, Voltas, Reliance Retail, and H&M. After finance roles, the top position is consultant.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very good, including the surroundings as it is surrounded by lush green fields, fresh air, and fresh water as well. Inside the campus, Wi-Fi works smoothly, but there are problems outside the buildings. The quality of food is good as it gets updated by the club of the mess every month.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: A Campus with strong grwoth & A fully student-driven culture that leads to top Business Schools.

content.Placements: In the past few years, there has been an increase in placements at IMT Hyderabad. The class of 2021-2023 included 186 students, with a decent mix of gender, educational attainment and job experience ranging from 0 to 36 months. Although DE shaw offered 25 LPA, Making him the highest- paid recruiter, the average increased to 11 LPA around from 7.64 LPA the year before. Hero Motocorp, Wipro, Deloitte, PWC, Cognizant, Reliance retail, EY, Accenture, Infosys & Numerous others were among the top employers. Students were given opportunities in a variety of fields, including those of Strategic Consultants, Strategic Consultants, Business Analyst, Management trainee etc.

individual_reviews.title: Good placements and infrastructure. Overall a good college to study.

JET is held for admisison to BTech, MBA, other UG and PG courses offered at Jain University. Candidates can take the exam from the comfort of their homes as it is an online test that can be taken from Desktop computers and laptop computers. The online proctored JET exam has MCQ-type questions. Candidates are selected based on their JET Score and fulfilling the eligibility criteria prescribed for the courses.

faqs.question: What is the seat intake for MCA at Jain University?
faqs.answer: Jain University offers a two-year MCA course across three specialisations. The total seat intake for this course is 100. To get a seat at Jain University MCA course, candidates must qualify for JET and PI round with a valid score.

paragraphs: Jain University is a deemed-to-be university that offers scholarships to its students based on six different categories. These scholarships are offered by the Jain University Scholarship Committee (JUSC) and are classified in various areas ranging from academic to extra-curricular categories. Apart from its regular students, the University also provides opportunities to candidates who are differently abled. To be eligible for Jain University Scholarship program students need to fulfill minimum educational qualifications with other requirements specified for each category.
Find the key highlights related to Jain University Scholarship in the table below:

Each student can apply only for any one category. All the detailed information such as scholarships category, requirements, and the year of the award are tabulated below:

The sports scholarship will remain to continue for a period of three years. After the completion of one year, players’ performance will be analysed based on their performance/ achievements in the state-level/ national-level and All Indian Ranking tournaments. The same criteria will be followed for the extension of the second-year scholarship. The third-year scholarship will be based on players’ performance in the second year.
If any aspiring candidate is not able to perform well in the first year then, JUSC may terminate the scholarship granted to the upcoming sports scholar.

At Jain University, scholarships to students in any of the six categories are provided through the University Scholarship Committee. After fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria, the selected students receive a Scholarship Offer Letter along with a Scholarship Acceptance Form. To apply for Jain University Scholarship follow the steps mentioned below:

reviews.review_heading: The college is worth the investment.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very amazing. Classrooms are designed in an amphi theatre style. They are air conditioned and equipped with the latest audio visual aid. This has made the learning very interactive with the teacher. Presence of ICT makes the environment conducive for learning.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The college was well-equipped. Air-conditioners were available in classrooms and hostel rooms with modern teaching and learning facilities. A gym was available. A TT room and a badminton court were provided. The hostel rooms were well-furnished. Two students shared a room.

reviews.review_heading: A place where you'll learn grow and have best memories for your life.
reviews.review_text: I'm a day scholar but my bestfriend stays at hostel and now when we are pursuing our internship, they are continuously told us how amazing the hostel was. The food is amazing and the electricity charge for s included in the fee itself. So for hostel I can assure you that it is amazing.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaipuria Jaipur - Jaipuria Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides us with all facilities. Classrooms have good furniture. Washrooms are clean. Classrooms are equipped with smart boards. Wi-Fi facility is available in the classrooms and hostel. The hostel is well-maintained. The food served in the hostel is good. Our college has computer labs. The library is available for students to read books in their free time.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaipuria Jaipur - Jaipuria Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides us with all facilities. Our college has a huge garden, trees, a fountain, etc. Our campus has greenery. Our college greenery. A huge library is available in our college. It has many books. Our classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners and LED screens.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaipuria Jaipur - Jaipuria Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides excellent infrastructure. The garden is huge. The campus has lush greenery. The premises are always clean and neat. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Our classrooms have huge LED screens, air-conditioners, and CCTV security. A library is available. Many books are available in the library. The hostel facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of placements and facilities.
reviews.review_text: College Facilities like Labs, Wi-Fi, Good Infrastructure and Library, Student Lounge, Cafeteria, Sports Room, and Music room are available. In the hostel, the quality of rooms is okay and there is a common room on every floor. The quality of food in the mess is not good. Medical facilities include a doctor who visits the hostel once-twice a week.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good and it provides a lot of facilities like Wi-Fi, Library, student lounge, Cafe-J, dance room, sports room, etc. Hostel facilities are quite good but the quality of food available in the mess is not good. As they also provided medical facilities where doctor visits every Thursday and Saturday.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements and has good returns on investment.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled with state of art labs designed by IBM and an auditorium. Students are there from all of the states of India. College also has an entrepreneurial cell and regularly organise workshops from top industry leaders. The hostel is equipped with Wi-Fi, induction, washing machine, gym, RO water coolers, and air conditioners as well. Students are also provided with an iron press and rooms are well ventilated with attached washrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with healthy learning & value for money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our campus is pretty amazing, surrounded by a beautiful atmosphere and greenery and all sorts of facilities are being provided by the college. I'm not a hosteler but I've visited the hostel and the rooms are very good as well as the food served in the mess is quite delicious. Talking about the classrooms and labs they are spacious and fully air-conditioned with great Wi-Fi facilities & equipped with all kind of necessities.

reviews.review_heading: Best teachers, good infrastructure, good placements, absolutely satisfied.
reviews.review_text:
Campus-wide Wi-Fi, computer labs, classrooms, a good library with several copies of prescribed text books, class video recording platform, Moodle for quizzes, assignment submissions etc. 
I live in a different state so haven't visited the campus yet.

reviews.review_heading: The best you could ever get.Excellent placement.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, cafeteria, separate boys and girls hotels with indoor gaming rooms, auditorium. 
There are proper hygiene and sanitation practices followed. The food which is provide is of good quality and is served keeping the hygiene standards in mind.

reviews.review_heading: B-school that feels like family!

The campus is well surrounded by high-speed Wi-Fi connection, which will ensure connectivity 24x7. I am a non-veg, but the quality of veg food they are offering is hygienic and very tasty. Two big grounds with all the sports accessories are provided. Recently we have organized a badminton competition for students and staff. An...

reviews.review_heading: Helpful, qualified, knowledgeable faculty
reviews.review_text:
The campus is completely technology driven from students to faculty everyone here uses a single digital platform from notes of all the subjects, attendance to class schedule on a single click. 
 The facilities in hostel is commendable from hygiene to health everything is being taken care of timely. The food is being prepared under safety protocols keeping in mind a balanced diet for a student. Every week the doctor visits the hostel so that students can consult. There are cycles for the hosteler...

reviews.review_text: Since I'm in Bangalore and have not visited the campus myself, I can not mention the details. college_info.college_name: Jaipuria Institute of Management Jaipur Scholarship Details

paragraphs: Jaipuria Institute of Management Jaipur provides financial assistance to eligible and deserving students through scholarships. The college encourages meritorious students with several scholarships as it also enhances the college's diversity and enables them to enroll outstanding candidates from various backgrounds. Jaipuria Jaipur scholarships are provided to students under three categories, i.e. based on entrance exam scores, Sibling scholarship, and IDFC First Bank scholarship.
Category 1: The college accepts various entrance exam scores for admission to the PGDM programme.

Category 2: The college also offers a Sibling scholarship worth INR 1,00,000 to students. The scholarship will be awarded on a first come first served basis to a limited number of scholars subject to admission in PGDM/MBA courses. Further, the scholarship for the second year will be based on the academic performance of year one.

Category 3: Jaipuria Jaipur offers an IDFC First Bank MBA scholarship which is a need-based programme worth INR 2,00,000 for 2 years of full-time MBA programme. It is mainly designed for students who come from families with an annual income of less than INR 6 lakh.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee at GGSIPU for MBA course?
overview_faqs.answer: Total course fee is total of multiple components such as tuition fee, library fee, registration fee, security deposit etc. Indraprastha University MBA fees range between INR 1.5 lakh and 5.65 lakh. This fee range includes MBA course fees at several IPU colleges. This information is taken from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. For more detail on fee structure, candidates are advised to contact admission department of University.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee at IPU?
overview_faqs.answer: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University's annual hostel cost is INR 29,500. Mess and welfare fees are not included in the hostel fees. The fee for the mess is INR 36,000, while the cost of the welfare is INR 3,000. Candidates need to submit three demand drafts: one for hostel fees, one for mess charges, and one for welfare charges. Two hostels are maintained on campus for male students, and two are maintained for female students. There are more than 180 single-seat rooms in each hostel. Basic furnishings such as a cot, mattress, pillow, chair, table, cupboard, tube lamp, and fan are provided in each room. Mess facilities are available for residents in each hostel. Residents also have access to a common area, a gym, a reading room, and sports facilities. For the hostels, there is a provision for 24-hour water and electrical services.

overview_faqs.question: Is CAT compulsory for MBA at IPU?
overview_faqs.answer: No, CAT is not the only exam based on which admission is granted. GGSIPU accepts the CAT percentile for MBA admission basis on which a merit list of selected candidates is released for the counselling round. Moreover, for the MBA in IT course, the university conducted IPU CET exam is accepted. In case the seats are left vacant after CAT candidates, then the seat allotment is carried out based on the candidate's CMAT scores.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college is spread over 60 acres, and placements are average.

content.Placements: About 60% are placed in companies like Infosys, Cisco, Oracle, JP Morgan, and Unthinkable. About 20% students got internships at Cisco, Oracle, and Infosys. Roles offered are full-stack developer, software engineer, cybersecurity engineer, and data analyst.
content.Infrastructure: The campus lacks Wi-Fi and internet connection in most parts, and even the library Wi-Fi does not work well. The hostel is pretty good, and separate rooms are provided to everyone. The campus offers different games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the atmosphere.

content.Placements: Many students were placed in my course, going as high as 60-70%. The average package offered in my course was easily around 10 LPA or more. Top recruiting companies from my courses are BMW Motors, SRM Chemical, etc. Almost all students got the opportunity for internships.
content.Infrastructure: Regarding the infrastructure and facilities available in our department, Wi-Fi is provided in all the departments. Labs are equipped with special equipment needed for the best performance and results. Classrooms are very good, and even the library is accessible.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with teachers, academics, college life. Not satisfied with placement and infrastructure.

content.Placements: 60-70% or even less are placed in the course I have admitted. The lowest package is around 3 LPA, the highest package is around 4.5 LPA, and the average is 3.5 LPA. Companies like TCS, Wipro, and Infosys are the main recruiters, and then startups. Not a lot idea about the internship, but it isn't a lot. Most students had to look for internships outside the campus. Roles as Software Developer, Frontend Developer, AI related roles.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is just okay, not a big campus, and also not a lot of sitting and playing area. Just a building block. The library, labs, and classroom are good, but you won't get Wi-Fi, so don't get your hope high. No hostel, so nothing related to that. The canteen is good, there are a few stalls of fast food, Nestlé, and all, so that works alright.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The best college for a technical course.

content.Placements: In my course, mostly 70% of students get placement. The highest package offered is 21 LPA, and the average package is 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Zomato, Microsoft, Wipro, and LinkedIn. Top roles offered by the companies are telecalling, web development, data analysis, and purchase assistance.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is so good, there are clean classes, well-hygiene washrooms, and an RO water service facility. There is Wi-Fi available in all classes, and the seminar halls are wide and have enough space for 200 students to be seated at once. Also, there are clean corridors.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great infrastructure, college with helpful faculty members and an overall good experience.

content.Placements: Around 70 to 80 percent of students were placed in the last recruiting. The highest package offered 10 LPA, while the average was around 4.5 LPA, and the lowest was 3 LPA. Infosys and Accenture are some of the companies recruiting. 60 percent of students got internship offers from Wipro and some new startup companies. Top roles tester development team.
content.Infrastructure: VIPS has one of the best infrastructures in the whole of GGSIPU. Classes are very good with the whole campus being centralized and air-conditioned. Wi-Fi is available, a very good library. It does not have its hostel. The canteen is very good in our college with a variety of food options available.

paragraphs: GGSIPU placement report for 2025 is yet to be released. However, as per the overall NIRF 2025 data, the median package offered UG-4 Year was INR 8.25 LPA . The median package offered to the UG 5-year was INR 8.39 LPA . While the median packages offered to the PG 1-Year and PG 2-Year students were INR 5.35 LPA and INR 6.95 LPA , respectively.

The University has released the placement report 2024 for GGSIPU’s University School of Information, Communication & Technology ( USICT ). The highest package offered at GGSIPU USICT was INR 41.2 LPA . The average package offered was INR 7.2 LPA . Further, 126 offers were made and 32 companies visited the campus during USICT placements 2024. Apart from this, according to USMS NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during IPU MBA placements 2023 stood at INR 6.18 LPA . In addition, a total of 160 students were placed out of 175 students during Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University MBA placements 2023.

review_summary.college_name: SOM, BML Munjal University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resources - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Mess food is good, which regularly changes.

content.Placements: Placements at college are quite decent. The MBA placements for the batch of 2019-21 got an average package of 7.13 LPA. The highest package is 11 LPA. The college has a strong placement team with various corporate tie ups. Some of the prominent recruiters are KPMG, Wipro, etc.
content.Infrastructure: There are a total of 5 hostels present in the college for both boys and girls. The mess is included in the hostel fees themselves, but there are only 2 messes for 5 hostels, and all are common for both boys and girls. The registration process in the hostel is very smooth, and the authorities will help us. The hostel fee is Rs. 10,000 per month, and it is 2 lakhs per year.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resources - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Good hostel with spacious rooms.

content.Placements: If you prepare well, you get placed easily. And if you skip presentations, assignments and classes, then it will be tough for you. The highest package is approximately 15 Lacs in Federal Bank. Almost 80% of students are placed. I also got an internship as a PPO with a magic pin in Head Quarters Gurgaon.
content.Infrastructure: I live in a triple-sharing apartment. We get our own balcony and a living room with 2 sofas, a center table, a sink, kitchen cabinets, a microwave, and a mini fridge. We also get our own bathroom with 2 showers, 2 basis and 2 toilets. The apartment has 3 rooms so the facilities are shared among 9 people. There is a water cooler right outside and a washing machine as well. The mess is included as part of the hostel fee. My hostel fees are 2 LPA.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resources - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: MBA in BML Munjal University.

content.Placements: BML Munjal University has good placement records so far. Nearly 1200+ students graduate from our university yearly. Additionally, 93 percent of students got placed in various companies with decent salary packages. My friends and I got placed in Lead Square with a salary package of 7 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: We were encouraged to play sports when we were interested in them. Apart from studies, they also allocate some time for playing sports. We won a lot of matches and trophies in sports tournaments conducted at the zonal level. The laboratories were properly maintained with all the necessary facilities.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resources - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Highly recommended college for MBA.

content.Placements: BML learning is very much related to the industry; anyone with good knowledge can easily get a job. Hyundai, Reliance Retail, Hero, Ola, and Axis Bank are top recruiters. Students are offered project-based internships. I got an internship at Reliance Retail. Top recruiters are Hero MotoCorp, KPMG, and others. Major companies are automobile companies. The average pay is 7.56 LPA, and the maximum package is 12.65 LPA. The college's relationship with companies is very strong, which helps in placements.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is amazing and is surrounded by lush greenery. The college is good in terms of amenities, with Wi-Fi available on campus, and labs are furnished with practice PCs. Some robberies occurred previously in the third wing of Hostel No. 1, but now security is very tight, with cameras everywhere. Parking space is limited, and sometimes hostel washrooms are not clean. The hostel mess offers many types of food, including snacks, breakfast, dinner, and lunch. There is a salon and branded medical safety services, but no hospital treatment is provided.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: My college journey at BML munjal university.

content.Placements: The highest, average, and lowest salary packages offered by recruiters are up to 18.5 Lacs, 4.5 Lacs, and 3.6 Lacs per annum, respectively. As 100% of students from BML Munjal University got placed in the 2023 placements. They are actively providing internship opportunities to our students.
content.Infrastructure: All modes of transportation are available from our college, so there is no need to worry about medical facilities and other such things. It is a healthy and peaceful campus. There is a specific menu to be followed by our canteen management, and free Wi-Fi facilities are available within the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Mess food is good, which regularly changes.
reviews.review_text: There are a total of 5 hostels present in the college for both boys and girls. The mess is included in the hostel fees themselves, but there are only 2 messes for 5 hostels, and all are common for both boys and girls. The registration process in the hostel is very smooth, and the authorities will help us. The hostel fee is Rs. 10,000 per month, and it is 2 lakhs per year.

reviews.review_heading: Good hostel with spacious rooms.
reviews.review_text: I live in a triple-sharing apartment. We get our own balcony and a living room with 2 sofas, a center table, a sink, kitchen cabinets, a microwave, and a mini fridge. We also get our own bathroom with 2 showers, 2 basis and 2 toilets. The apartment has 3 rooms so the facilities are shared among 9 people. There is a water cooler right outside and a washing machine as well. The mess is included as part of the hostel fee. My hostel fees are 2 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: MBA in BML Munjal University.
reviews.review_text: We were encouraged to play sports when we were interested in them. Apart from studies, they also allocate some time for playing sports. We won a lot of matches and trophies in sports tournaments conducted at the zonal level. The laboratories were properly maintained with all the necessary facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Highly recommended college for MBA.
reviews.review_text: The campus is amazing and is surrounded by lush greenery. The college is good in terms of amenities, with Wi-Fi available on campus, and labs are furnished with practice PCs. Some robberies occurred previously in the third wing of Hostel No. 1, but now security is very tight, with cameras everywhere. Parking space is limited, and sometimes hostel washrooms are not clean. The hostel mess offers many types of food, including snacks, breakfast, dinner, and lunch. There is a salon and branded medica...

reviews.review_heading: My college journey at BML munjal university.
reviews.review_text: All modes of transportation are available from our college, so there is no need to worry about medical facilities and other such things. It is a healthy and peaceful campus. There is a specific menu to be followed by our canteen management, and free Wi-Fi facilities are available within the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review on BML munjal University.
reviews.review_text: The college intake is very high, and the campus has become small. There are a lot of students who are all very friendly. Annual festivals happen last month of the year; there are teachfests after the month of the semester. There are every required textbook and journal in the library. You can also make requests for books that are not available in the library. We have an E library and an E lab facility, but we do not require an E lab; it is for engineering students. Wi-Fi service is available in l...

reviews.review_heading: College is really good and fulfills all the requirements.
reviews.review_text: Life at the campus is really amazing, it is surrounded by lush greenery. The campus has modern well-equipped classrooms including digital boards and projectors. There are separate hostels for boys and girls. The hostel fees is 2 lacs per year. The campus has a small ground compared to the number of student intakes. The Library has the best infrastructure and is the best place to study. Mess food is of above average quality with veg and non veg food being served by the mess.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities for the course of MBA.
reviews.review_text: BML University has a vibrant campus. Infrastructure of our college was good. Facilities available in the college for the students include labs, library, Wi-Fi, sports, big classrooms, canteen, etc. The facilities provided were of good quality. Hostel and medical facilities were also available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: BML Munjal is the best college for MBA.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure that are available to us here at BML Munjal University are the best; the college has been providing us with all the basic amenities throughout the year with the best quality and at very affordable prices; and the mess food at the college is also great.

reviews.review_heading: Our college doesn't provide good placements for marketing.
reviews.review_text: The pedagogy of the MBA is designed by imperial college London which makes this college unique. It lays more emphasis on practical knowledge rather than theoretical knowledge and promotes hands-on learning.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the Placement.
reviews.review_text: There is a inbuilt Wi-Fi connectivity through out the whole campus. Hostels are provided in the form of Towers and apartment. The maximum room sharing is 4. There are 2 mess in which food is served 4 times a day. There are indoor as well as outdoor sports in the college.

reviews.review_heading: In love with the campus not so much with the location.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure and facilities, I think our university does a great job in that. The library is one of the best places to be with plenty of books to read and study in a strict and quiet environment. Then comes hostel with good rooms and hygiene, toilets are cleaned every day as well as the rooms we live in. The quality of food is also okay not the best but not the worst too.

reviews.review_heading: It is a university with a practical approach to learning.
reviews.review_text: The whole campus is spread over around 50 acres of area. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, with multiple sports like football, lawn tennis, basketball, cricket, badminton, etc. We have two messes, along with that 2 separate cafeterias. The library is awesome, and facilities like the Bloomberg terminal are also available. The hostel is quite good, and the rooms are spacious. A lift facility is also available in both academic and hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Review of School of Management, BML Munjal University.
reviews.review_text: Campus life is very good, with great infrastructure. The college has amazing and well-equipped Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms with all modern facilities. The college mess is quite hygienic, and the food available here is very good. The campus is lush green in and around. Hostel facilities are amazing on the campus, and students have access to games on the campus, such as cricket, football and tennis.

reviews.review_heading: BMU always emphasises on learning by doing methodology.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available are good, and the quality of food available in mess and canteen is good. The hostel, medical facilities, sports, etc., are good. All the infrastructure is properly maintained and well furnished. Good security measures are taken for the safety of students.

faqs.question: Can I join MBA at Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing without 70% in Graduation?
faqs.answer: Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing offers admission to MBA courses solely on the basis of merit obtained in graduation. However, the college has specified a minimum aggregate of 50% in Graduation. Candidates with 50% or more have a pretty good chance at getting into CCSM. However, candidate also need to appear for an entrance exam (CTA/ XAT/ MAT/ CMAT/ NMAT) to secure admission to Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing?
faqs.answer: Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing offers admission solely on the basis of merit. The admission to all courses is based on the merit acquired in the qualifying exam as well as scores obtained in the course-level entrance exam (CAT/ XAT/ MAT/ CMAT/ NMAT). Candidates who wish to apply to CCSM, must fulfil the course-specific eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams are accepted by Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing?
faqs.answer: Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing offers admission to an MBA programme. Admission to the courses is based completely on the merit. Candidates are required to appear for an entrance exam, in order to secure admission. CCSM Chandigarh only accepts CAT, CMAT, XAT, MAT, and NMAT scores for admissions.

faqs.question: Is entrance exam required for admission at Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing?
faqs.answer: Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing considers entrance exam scores for admission. Candidates with a valid score in CAT, CMAT, XAT, MAT, and NMAT can get admission in the MBA programme. The tests evaluates the quantitative, verbal, and logical reasoning abilities of the candidates. A valid score in either of these exams is a prerequisite for admission. Once selected, candidates also need to pass other selection rounds i.e. group discussion and personal interview.

faqs.question: How can I check Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing cutoff for MBA?
faqs.answer: Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing offers admission to the MBA programme on the basis of the scores obtained in CAT/ XAT/ MAT/ CMAT/ NMAT. The institute releases the entrance exam cutoff for the course. Candidates can check the cutoff for MBA courses on the official website of the Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing.

review_summary.college_name: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Affordable education with good infrastructure and below-average placement support.

content.Placements: I belonged to the B.Com (Hons) batch at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Lucknow. Placement opportunities are average. The highest package offered is around 4 LPA-5 LPA, the lowest package is about 1.8 LPA-2 LPA, and the average package stood at approximately 2.5 LPA-3 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies that visited the campus included TCS, Infosys (support roles), HDFC Bank, etc. About 40-50 percent of students managed to get internships mostly in banks. Many students also secured internships on their own through online platforms. The top roles offered are Accounts Executive, Junior Accountant, etc.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Journalism and Mass Communication - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: College was pretty fine, value for money, but average compared to good media colleges.

content.Placements: Hardly 10% of students got placed. The highest package was 3.6 LPA, and the lowest was 2.2 LPA. Only 5 out of 50 students got placement, that too on the professor's personal favors and relations. So, you have to prepare and place yourself by searching for a decent job on your own, otherwise, it is tough here.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi and labs were available, but we rarely had lab visits. The hostels were nice with average food. There were many hostels, only students from outside Uttar Pradesh got a hostel here, so be prepared for hostel and mess expenses if you are from Uttar Pradesh itself.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Best university for M.Sc. in physics course.

content.Placements: Currently, the placements happening for us. In my senior batch, 90% of them were placed. Many companies come in looking for jobs, but most companies come in looking for employment and financial information. We had a great choice of dual specialisation, which made it easier for us to clarify what to do for the best placements. The roles offered were aeronautical engineer, laboratory technician, etc. Internships were offered.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel was nice and completely furnished with Wi-Fi and beds. The cuisine at the hostel was superb. The infrastructure of our lab was excellent. Our classrooms were tidy. Our college had digital classrooms. Hospital and eateries were beneficial. Our college promoted student participation in sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is a nice place with 24/7 library access.

content.Placements: There are 100 students in my course. The highest package is 5 lacs, and the lowest is 3 lacs. Others included several NGOs, schools, and coaching centers. The teaching role involved an internship in a government school. All students completed their internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The department had a library and a smart classroom, which was helpful for micro-teaching and simulated teaching. Most girls stayed in the hostel, while about 70% of the boys had to stay outside the campus. The food in the hostel was good.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Life Sciences - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Professors are very helpful in nature. It is a good university.

content.Placements: The batch is very good, there are 32 students in my class. The college faculty members do not allow us to do internships. In the last semester, there was a training program held by the university. The training programme is held by ICAR in Nainital. But they take money for this, and we go on to study tour in Uttarakhand.
content.Infrastructure: There is a very poor Wi-Fi connection, and the library is good. Classrooms do not have AC. In the hostel, the mess food is a disaster. The canteen is also not so good. Medical facilities are very fast but not so good. Sports and games are also available in this college. The central library is very good with full AC.

hostel_campus.college_name: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Affordable education with good infrastructure and below-average placement support.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University is quite good and well spread across a large green campus. Classrooms for B.Com (Hons) are spacious and well-ventilated. The university has a central library with a good collection of commerce, management, and reference books along with reading halls. Wi-Fi facility is available on campus. Hostel facilities are decent with separate hostels for boys and girls. Rooms are clean and basic amenities like water and electricity are provided. T...

reviews.review_heading: College was pretty fine, value for money, but average compared to good media colleges.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs were available, but we rarely had lab visits. The hostels were nice with average food. There were many hostels, only students from outside Uttar Pradesh got a hostel here, so be prepared for hostel and mess expenses if you are from Uttar Pradesh itself.

reviews.review_heading: Best university for M.Sc. in physics course.
reviews.review_text: Hostel was nice and completely furnished with Wi-Fi and beds. The cuisine at the hostel was superb. The infrastructure of our lab was excellent. Our classrooms were tidy. Our college had digital classrooms. Hospital and eateries were beneficial. Our college promoted student participation in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: It is a nice place with 24/7 library access.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The department had a library and a smart classroom, which was helpful for micro-teaching and simulated teaching. Most girls stayed in the hostel, while about 70% of the boys had to stay outside the campus. The food in the hostel was good.

reviews.review_heading: Professors are very helpful in nature. It is a good university.
reviews.review_text: There is a very poor Wi-Fi connection, and the library is good. Classrooms do not have AC. In the hostel, the mess food is a disaster. The canteen is also not so good. Medical facilities are very fast but not so good. Sports and games are also available in this college. The central library is very good with full AC.

reviews.review_heading: Good lush green campus and well-equipped library.
reviews.review_text: We have fully ventilated and Wi-Fi enabled classroom, computer labs, and library with all the relevant books for study. As for the hostels, they are very good in condition. The food in canteen is average. We also have a medical facility available for us. We have playground with all types of sports and one sports center for indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great place for education. It has a good infrastructure, but there is a lack of placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus has a good infrastructure with pace and calmness. Every department has a Wi-Fi facility with good speed. All classrooms are also well-maintained and specially structured to prevent suffocation problems. It has good ventilation, a great library, etc.

reviews.review_heading: A college with attractive campus and helpful faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very excellent. Wi-Fi is also very good, and classrooms are fully AC. The library is also fully AC and Wi-Fi is available 24*7. Hostels are also very good, according to price. The mess and canteen food are far better than those at other colleges. There is a health centre in the university for students. Sports events are also organised at the university.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Central University, Lucknow.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are nice and clean, but the only demerit is that most people don't get a hostel as there is not a sufficient number of hostels. The rooms are okay, but not very good. Overall, the hostel facilities and mess are good, and you can expect a hostel if you are not close to the college.

reviews.review_heading: I hope for betterment soon.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are still lacking because this course is very new at the university. Hostels are pretty good, and the quality of food is also nice. There are many opportunities for a person if he or she is into sports. There are many clubs, and the library is one of the best in this college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with 80% placements in 2024. It has good staff members and professors.
reviews.review_text: We will get accommodation facility in form of hostels which is generally 2-3 seaters. Water, Wi-Fi, and electricity facilities are available for free. There is a fee of around Rs. 2,600 per semester for the hostel. Few hostels have a gym and common room with AC to study. Guest rooms for parents are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Some departments have good management but some do not. The college life is fun here.
reviews.review_text: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU) in Lucknow has areas that could be improved. The positive aspects are it is beautiful and green. Wi-Fi is available at departments and hostels. Some Classrooms are equipped with smart boards in some departments.

faqs.answer: TANCET participating colleges define the TANCET cutoff scores or the last ranks for admission. However, participating institutes do not release a cutoff list for candidates to check during the admission process. In fact the cutoff scores are not released by any authority during the admission session. Candidates can find the TANCET cutoff scores and TANCET last ranks, from the previous admission session, published on the official admission website, I. e. Tamil Nadu-mbamca. Com. All queries related to the centralised admission, counselling, cutoffs, vacancy details, among other information is published on the counselling website, aka the admission website. Directorate of Technical Education, Chennai, has the authority to publish the previous year TANCET cutoff on the official admission website.
faqs.question: Who releases TANCET cutoff scores?

faqs.answer: TANCET rank is allotted based on the percentile score of the candidate. In case two candidates have a similar percentile score, he/she will be allotted a rank as per the following criteria. Firstly, candidates having a higher average percentage of marks in the first semester to N-1 semesters in the qualifying degree exam are ranked higher. Here N indicates the total number of semesters in the qualifying exam. In case the tie persist, the older candidate as per the date of birth in the SSLC Certificate will get the preference in the rank allotment.

faqs.question: Is MAT required for MBA at Thiagarajar School of Management?
